chapters.title: Chapter 451: Are You Sure...
paragraphs: "Are you saying the Forest King body you bought at the auction was used in creating that terrifying lady that just appeared?" Lady Lani, who was still in shock, asked.
"Indeed." Kent decided to calm her nerves down a bit, so he gave her something to be shocked about.
What he didn’t expect was her reaction. It was like she had heard the most unbelievable thing in the world. Even mentioning that the world would soon come to an end didn’t seem to worry her much.
Nara could just hold her friend through her shocked moment.
When she recovered, she could only stare at Kent for as long as she could. When she had enough, she chose to take a breather.
"Take care of her while I am gone," Kent said to Nara.
"Where are you going? You have already called more danger onto yourself, so you should probably leave this city before it’s too late," Nara said.
"That wouldn’t solve the problem, would it?" Kent asked. Of course, he can’t just ignore a quest packed with dozens of rewards.
"The moment I choose to run, they will become more aggressive and perhaps do more harm than they’ve already done.
Of course, I can get stronger before returning to face them. But that wouldn’t be fun, would it?
So I will stay, and with my strength now, I will ensure everyone becomes aware of the danger they will face in the future after I get even stronger.
So I will stay and kill as many as I can."
Nara sighed.
"Weren’t you the same person that said the world is coming to an end? Why kill them when you can take them as allies through negotiation?"
"Even you don’t believe in what you just said. But while having them as allies would be good, I don’t see that outcome as favourable to me.
Of course, the world is big, and I will meet allies, but why settle for scum when you can use their bodies to create better warriors?
This is why I will kill them and use their bodies to make better warriors who are reliable and won’t run in fear when the apocalypse descends.
Trust me, it’s the best for all of us." Kent looked toward Lady Lani’s direction and smiled. "Feel free to tell her what she wanted to know. She is family now."
His smile bloomed.
Nara sighed and walked away.
Kent also sighed and looked at the time left until his fourth undead would be created.
’A little over three days. I better get started then.’ He left the hotel to meet with Sword King Shawn.
The moment he was gone, Lady Lani turned to her friend.
"Nara, tell me, just who is Kent? I chose to accompany him this time so I could learn more about him, but it seems he is someone I just can’t understand."
"Join the wagon," Nara smiled.
"I am trying to understand him, but at every turn, it was like he becomes even more mysterious."
The two ladies sat down and started to talk more about Kent.
Meanwhile, in a private room in a certain inn, Kent was now seated across from Sword Saint Shawn, who was now more interested in knowing more about Kent.
Their conversation lasted for four good hours before Kent left. Kent made sure he told him all he knew about the Hand, considering he had already seen his reaction and knew he wanted to know.
After he left the Inn, he made his way toward a certain direction that was not the hotel where the two ladies were waiting for him.
After moving for a while, he entered yet another inn and booked an empty private room. He ordered a tea and sat down to drink.
A few minutes into his drink, a figure entered the inn, ordered a drink, and sat in a separate room.
"You do know following people around isn’t polite, right?" Kent said, taking a sip of his drink.
"I don’t know if you would want to talk to me after what happened during the competition," the voice spoke from the other room.
Of course, they each spoke like they were whispering. However, it was heard by each other.
They were just using spiritual qi to speak, so you wouldn’t hear anything unless someone knew what was happening.
Even if you were sitting across from them, they wouldn’t hear what they were saying.
"You followed me either way, so you might as well tell me what you want," Kent said.
"You know why I am here already, don’t you? The last time, you said I have a poison in my body. If you could tell that at just a glance, then I am sure you know more than I am telling you."
Kent smirked, sipping his tea.
"Tell me, did you kill the person whose skin you are wearing?"
"Yes. And before you think ill of me, know that she deserved it."
"I see. Then what do you want from me?" Kent asked again.
"I want you to help me cure the poison, and in return, I will serve you for ten years."
Kent lowered his teacup and looked at the lady who was also looking in his direction despite a wall blocking them.
The look on her wrinkled face said it all. She was damn serious.
"That is a huge commitment," Kent said.
"I waited 72 years for this moment, so I believe I can wait for ten more years." There was no hesitation in her tone, nor did she show any sign of doubt.
"Are you sure?" Kent asked.
"I am," the lady replied.
"I see." Kent took yet another sip.
"Although I would love to have you as my servant, I have integrity. You clearly have a reason for taking on this identity, so setting you back ten years wouldn’t be good.
So I have a different offer that will benefit you regardless. If you are done with your business and you still want to repay me for curing you, I will be willing to take you as my servant."
Kent set his cup down and took a vial containing the cure from his space ring.
He vanished, and the next second, he was inside the next room where the wicked Poison Witch was sitting.
"Happy hunting." He set the vial and a communication token down before vanishing away. The next second, he was 4 km away.
Meanwhile, far at the core universe, the beautiful lady smiled...
"Oh, Chaos, though you are running from your destiny, sometimes you can’t run too far. Destiny has a way of catching up to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 452: Calm Before The Storm
paragraphs: Three days had already passed since Kent publicly embarrassed the Pill Saints.

The four kingdoms heard of what he did, and while those who knew he was right applauded him, the shameless ones started organizing their shameless campaign, with some even planning to take advantage of the chaos that was coming.
If only they knew that they could not easily navigate the chaos this time.
One has to know that shamelessness doesn’t mean one should be stupid.
Kent was shameless, but he knew when to run from danger, and right now, he knew the dangers coming weren’t ones that could be avoided.
But these people, despite Kent not going against them, chose to bring chaos upon themselves.
They will learn it the hard way, for Kent has already made plans. He was only waiting for the time to come.
Naturally, he was prepared from the moment he entered the city for the Pill Master Competition.
A day ago, the Wicked Poison Witch contacted him and made him aware that the Pill Saints had already made their move and that he should be careful.
She also said she wouldn’t be participating, so Kent shouldn’t hold any grudge against her and her disciple.
Kent, of course, already expected that, so he wasn’t surprised.
He asked where she would go, but her reply was rather cold.
"You will find out in the coming days."
Kent knew the lady was going to shock the kingdoms, and he, for one, was looking forward to that.
Now, sleeping on the comfortable lap, the fourth Night Rider is Kent, who just couldn’t get enough of the soft and welcoming lap he was privileged to have.
"Lady Lani, I know this may come as a shock, but you won’t be joining the battle that is about to happen." Kent turned and spoke to the beautiful assassin, who frowned.
"You can’t tell me what to do and what not to do," she responded, already planning on fighting beside her friend.
"And if you are worried about my identity getting exposed, you won’t have to worry much. I have that covered."
"You do know the battle coming isn’t one even I know of its magnitude. And while it’s admirable to see your want to fight for my cause, I also don’t want you getting any backlash.
You can sit out this one, for there is more to come in the future."
"I will fight, and that is final. Or are you underestimating me?"
"Kent, no need to argue with her. She is that annoying. The more you prohibit her from doing something, the more she wants to do it," Nara said, brushing Kent’s hair with her hand.
The past three days had brought them closer. Even Lady Lani seemed to have gotten closer to him than a couple of days before.
"Very well. I wouldn’t want to restrict you, but you must take this." Kent retrieved a necklace from his space ring.
"The moment your life is in danger, it will come in handy. Just wear it for now." She didn’t object and put the necklace on.
"I don’t know the magnitude of the battle we are about to fight. What will you do if a Forest King or Kingdom Protector pops up?
Master said she doesn’t trust the other three Kingdom Protectors. This means I don’t, either. So what are you going to do about that?" Lady Lani asked.
Kent smiled and looked at her.
"Though I don’t like to brag, I faced a god just a few weeks ago and gave him the middle finger. So a Kingdom Protector or a Forest King should be the least of my worries."
Lady Lani turned and looked at Nara.
"He doesn’t lie." That was all Nara could say, for she knew that despite Kent saying those words with an unserious smile, he meant every word.
Though, the god part seemed to be exaggerated a bit.
The beautiful assassin could only stare at the brat for as long as her mind could comprehend what she had just heard.
Of course, she has her own agenda in this battle, and thanks to Kent, it will be realised.
Meanwhile, somewhere in Vastport City, 14 hooded figures could be seen getting ready—or more accurately, looking ready—for a great battle.
Not that much attention could be placed on them.
The true threat was rather far from Vastport City in the persons of eight individuals, each at the Root Sovereign stage.
These eight are the assassins from the Middle Finger Assassin Guild.
The hand that has its hand in everything in the entire world has tasked them with handling this mission. Kent is doomed per their plan for this mission.
"Is everything in place?" the leader of the assassins asked.
"Yes, Leader," they answered.
"Very well. How about our allies? Are they also in position?"
"Yes, Leader. The Evil Sect has already laid their traps and is just waiting for the brat to come out of the city gates."
"Then we should be ready for what comes next. This time, we cannot fail, for failure is not an option."
"We won’t fail this one, Leader."
The leader, who was at the 8th level of the Root Sovereign stage, nodded. He wanted this mission to go well; naturally, it was meant to be easy.
However, the person they are going after is no easy human. Many with strength so great have already fallen going against him, so they aren’t underestimating him.
Meanwhile, somewhere else, also outside the city, the Evil Sect, with its evil presence, was lying in wait for the mouse to enter its trap.
"Remember, the end game is to capture his soul," a skinny, almost bony old man holding a twisted staff said. His eerie tone was enough to make a person quake in their boots.
"His death shouldn’t be merciful, for he has caused us to lose a lot."
"Grand Sect Leader, we’ve already made provisions. He will die by all means."
"How about his body?" a dark-eyed, large, bald-headed fellow asked. "From what the Sect Master told us, his spirit root is of the highest grade, so turning him into a corpse puppet wouldn’t be bad."
"The body is what those assassins are after. Right now, we can’t afford to lose any more manpower. So let them have it.
We can go for it from them when we recover our strength. For now, they are our allies, and we must let them not suspect a thing"

chapters.title: Chapter 453: Kent Vs The Four Kingdoms (1)
paragraphs: The time is nearing evening, with the sun falling below the horizon.
Vastport City is perched atop a small mountainous area, so the sunset is rather good for a cold sunset murder.
To mere mortals, the environment and air around them seem normal. But to cultivators, they could sense something ominous was amiss.
The danger in the air is palpable to them, so currently, a large section of Vasport City stands empty. The cultivator who sensed the danger ensured the mortals were unaffected.
Someone may have also mysteriously alerted them to the presence of the Evil Sect, prompting them to evacuate without question.
Currently, the only one visible in the evacuated section of the city is Kent, eating an apple as he strolls down the road toward the city gate.
Looking at him, one could tell he wasn’t paying much attention to the changes in the air.
Suddenly, a figure appeared in the sky and threw four flagpoles, forming a box around Kent. The moment the flagpoles landed, the space around Kent seemed to start closing in.
"I’ll say it only once: Hand over the battle dolls," declared the figure, a Root Ascension stage cultivator at the fourth level.
One could swear his tone is that of someone taking something that once belonged to them.
Judging by his demeanor, Kent could tell he was a refiner, but because he wore a mask, his identity remained hidden from all those watching.
"What if I refuse to give you my dolls?" Kent asked with a smirk.
In response, the masked figure formed a hand seal, and four energy beams shot upward from the flagpoles, converging into a massive flame dragon.
The moment the dragon appeared, Kent felt its strength.
’A tier 8 soul attack that can also deal physical damage. Not a bad move for a soul refiner. Too bad he picked me as his target.’
Kent looked at the masked figure and scoffed.
"I never knew an elder from the Soul Refining Sect would come after me." Kent smirked, "Elder Chen Kai, is your sect master aware you are here trying to steal from me?"
The masked figure didn’t react outwardly, but Kent could sense his unease. He had just unveiled his identity in a rather disappointing way.
"Die!" he bellowed, unleashing the dragon. It circled above before descending on Kent.
The flaming dragon opened its mouth wide, about to swallow Kent, who stood motionless, when suddenly, a crimson sword arc flashed from the clouds and sliced through the dragon, cutting it in half.
"What?" Elder Chen Kai muttered as the dragon was severed by an invisible swordsman.
Of course, the person appeared the next second, holding her dark sword, bathed in red streaks of abyssal energy.
"No need to look shocked; that attack didn’t have much substance." Nara smirked as she appeared beside Kent.
"I don’t know if your sect is using you to come after me, but I’ll kill you and visit them one of these days for an explanation."
Kent smiles in a certain direction before turning back to Elder Chen Kai
"Now obey me and die."
It was a simple statement, but up in the air, Chen Kai fell and slammed into the ground, dying instantly. Kent waved his hand, and the flags vanished into his tower storage.
The body on the ground also disappeared. It was a soul attack made through verbal command, and because Chen Kai was only a Tier 8 soul cultivator, he couldn’t withstand it.
Though hidden, those who witnessed what had just happened broke into a cold sweat. Those watching from afar were the same.
They clearly saw how Kent ordered someone to die, and he did. It was something nobody expected, yet it happened, and looking at the expression on his face, they could tell he had only just begun.
"Hello, those hiding! Hurry up and come to your death. I don’t have all day."

"Why wait when we can kill them where they’re hiding?" Ingrid’s voice boomed as space cracked in five different places. From these cracks, spears shot out, causing painful screams to echo across the area.
They died screaming.
A larger crack appeared in the sky, and Ingrid walked out, clad in her dark leather armor, wielding her spear like the huntress she was.
"Such a show-off. Watch how I handle them," Neomi also said, not wanting her disciple and sister to have all the fun.
She appeared out of nowhere and blinked away, appearing in seven places simultaneously.
In under a second, she severed the head of another seven people before the clones she had created merged back together.
At this point, many people started running, as most were only there to take advantage of the chaos and see if they could score a loot or two.
However, some could only fly a few kilometers before Lilian spoke.
"That’s the thing. While I’m still alive, nobody can leave my confinement."

All those fleeing felt their bodies restricted as Lilian’s spell took effect and enveloped them. Before they could move, lightning arrows descended upon them, showing that Unity had also joined the fray.
At this point, only five people remained hidden, considering that Unity, Lilian, Ingrid, Neomi, and Nara had already revealed themselves.
Kent, of course, knew they were already around because they had arrived yesterday and had put measures in place. They even created their own unique entrances just to make it look impressive.
But while that was happening with his ladies, Lady Lani, who had said she needed to kill a few people before joining them, was moving through the shadows, nearly invisible to everyone.
In one part of the city, a Peak Ascension stage cultivator, also a Sage swordsman, lay in wait, hoping to take advantage of a moment when Kent would be vulnerable.
Suddenly, he felt his surroundings shift and quickly drew his sword. But before he could act, a dagger pressed against his throat, and a chilling, comical voice whispered in his ear.
"I bet you didn’t see that coming, Rand." The dagger moved the next second, taking his head off.
Lady Lani spoke those words, neither too long nor too short—just enough for Rand to realize who she was before dying.
One could say she ensured he died knowing who killed him.
A few meters away, a dark bird perched on a tree shook its head, looking in Lady Lani’s direction.
Meanwhile, her master, miles away, smiled.
"This is a perfect opportunity for you to handle all your enemies, Lani. I wonder how many you’ll be willing to kill this time, considering Kent called all of them to gather in one place."
There is an assassin on this continent known to many as the Joker. She earned this name because, whenever she killed, she left a smiling face carved out of paper on the body.
Those who saw her and lived said she wore a smiling face mask.
However, her true identity was known only to two people: Protector Vari and Nara.
Just now, she had killed one of the targets in her book and placed her signature, smiling face paper, on the body.
She then turned and looked in a certain direction.
"Looks like it’s going to be a good one," she giggled through her smiling mask, melted into the shadows, and vanished.

In response, the masked figure formed a hand seal, and four energy beams shot upward from the flagpoles, converging into a massive flame dragon.
The moment the dragon appeared, Kent felt its strength.
’A tier 8 soul attack that can also deal physical damage.
Not a bad move for a soul refiner.
Too bad he picked me as his target.’
Kent looked at the masked figure and scoffed.
"I never knew an elder from the Soul Refining Sect would come after me." Kent smirked, "Elder Chen Kai, is your sect master aware you are here trying to steal from me?"
The masked figure didn’t react outwardly, but Kent could sense his unease.
He had just unveiled his identity in a rather disappointing way.
"Die!" he bellowed, unleashing the dragon.
It circled above before descending on Kent.
The flaming dragon opened its mouth wide, about to swallow Kent, who stood motionless, when suddenly, a crimson sword arc flashed from the clouds and sliced through the dragon, cutting it in half.
"What?" Elder Chen Kai muttered as the dragon was severed by an invisible swordsman.
Of course, the person appeared the next second, holding her dark sword, bathed in red streaks of abyssal energy.
"No need to look shocked; that attack didn’t have much substance." Nara smirked as she appeared beside Kent.
"I don’t know if your sect is using you to come after me, but I’ll kill you and visit them one of these days for an explanation."
Kent smiles in a certain direction before turning back to Elder Chen Kai
"Now obey me and die."
It was a simple statement, but up in the air, Chen Kai fell and slammed into the ground, dying instantly.
Kent waved his hand, and the flags vanished into his tower storage.
The body on the ground also disappeared.
It was a soul attack made through verbal command, and because Chen Kai was only a Tier 8 soul cultivator, he couldn’t withstand it.
Though hidden, those who witnessed what had just happened broke into a cold sweat.
Those watching from afar were the same.
They clearly saw how Kent ordered someone to die, and he did.
It was something nobody expected, yet it happened, and looking at the expression on his face, they could tell he had only just begun.
"Hello, those hiding!
Hurry up and come to your death.
I don’t have all day."
"Why wait when we can kill them where they’re hiding?" Ingrid’s voice boomed as space cracked in five different places.
From these cracks, spears shot out, causing painful screams to echo across the area.
They died screaming.
A larger crack appeared in the sky, and Ingrid walked out, clad in her dark leather armor, wielding her spear like the huntress she was.
"Such a show-off.
Watch how I handle them," Neomi also said, not wanting her disciple and sister to have all the fun.
She appeared out of nowhere and blinked away, appearing in seven places simultaneously.
In under a second, she severed the head of another seven people before the clones she had created merged back together.
At this point, many people started running, as most were only there to take advantage of the chaos and see if they could score a loot or two.
However, some could only fly a few kilometers before Lilian spoke.
"That’s the thing.
While I’m still alive, nobody can leave my confinement."
All those fleeing felt their bodies restricted as Lilian’s spell took effect and enveloped them.
Before they could move, lightning arrows descended upon them, showing that Unity had also joined the fray.
At this point, only five people remained hidden, considering that Unity, Lilian, Ingrid, Neomi, and Nara had already revealed themselves.
Kent, of course, knew they were already around because they had arrived yesterday and had put measures in place.
They even created their own unique entrances just to make it look impressive.
But while that was happening with his ladies, Lady Lani, who had said she needed to kill a few people before joining them, was moving through the shadows, nearly invisible to everyone.
In one part of the city, a Peak Ascension stage cultivator, also a Sage swordsman, lay in wait, hoping to take advantage of a moment when Kent would be vulnerable.
Suddenly, he felt his surroundings shift and quickly drew his sword.
But before he could act, a dagger pressed against his throat, and a chilling, comical voice whispered in his ear.
"I bet you didn’t see that coming, Rand." The dagger moved the next second, taking his head off.
Lady Lani spoke those words, neither too long nor too short—just enough for Rand to realize who she was before dying.
One could say she ensured he died knowing who killed him.
A few meters away, a dark bird perched on a tree shook its head, looking in Lady Lani’s direction.
Meanwhile, her master, miles away, smiled.
"This is a perfect opportunity for you to handle all your enemies, Lani.
I wonder how many you’ll be willing to kill this time, considering Kent called all of them to gather in one place."
There is an assassin on this continent known to many as the Joker.
She earned this name because, whenever she killed, she left a smiling face carved out of paper on the body.
Those who saw her and lived said she wore a smiling face mask.
However, her true identity was known only to two people: Protector Vari and Nara.
Just now, she had killed one of the targets in her book and placed her signature, smiling face paper, on the body.
She then turned and looked in a certain direction.
"Looks like it’s going to be a good one," she giggled through her smiling mask, melted into the shadows, and vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Kent Vs The Four Kingdoms (2)
paragraphs: Nobody knew where they came from.
They just appeared out of nowhere and started displaying shocking abilities, killing as many as they could, even going so far as to trap all those who wanted to run.
This sight was shocking, and looking at the hidden figures emerging only to be killed before they could plead for their lives, one had to say that Kent came prepared this time.
Kent was only walking toward the city gate while his ladies handled matters inside the city. They didn’t let even a fly come near their man.
Talk about qualities of a good harem. Kent could only smile as he moved away.
Three figures appeared out of nowhere a couple of meters from the gate, lunging at Kent. However, before they reached a meter from him, the wind blew past Kent, causing him to smile.
The three lunging at him stopped mid-attack as their heads fell off their bodies.
"You can’t be careless, dear," Selene said, smiling back at Kent.
"Oh, but I can be careless knowing you are around." Kent smiled and then looked to his side, where Mara also appeared, dancing through the air with her sword.
Camilla also made her appearance on his left, and just looking at how quickly she was moving with her attacks, one could tell she was rather skilled with the spear.
"I don’t want to ask, but where is Val?" Kent asked, not seeing her around.
Selene smiled and pointed in a certain direction.
"She located someone she needed to kill first, so she is fighting him. But don’t worry, Elsa and the soul sentinels are around. She won’t get into any trouble."
Kent just smiled and summoned Saden.
"Join Unity and keep her safe." Saden nodded and moved in Unity’s direction.
Unity wasn’t like her sister, who had True Names. She was just a level 5 Root Great Sage, so he was slightly overprotective of her.
Not that her life would be in any danger; he had already given her the necklace that would save her whenever her life was in danger by teleporting her into the tower.
Kent looked in Val’s direction again and smiled.
"You can go, Kent. We will handle them here and join you soon," Selene said before returning to action.
"Have fun, y’all," Kent smiled before he started moving again.
Outside the city, the Middle Finger Assassins remained hidden, with only their leader visible. Not that it mattered, considering the plans Kent had for them.
A couple of meters away in the other direction, the Evil Sect was also waiting for him.
However, they weren’t the only ones.
Some unknown figures could also be seen not far from them, ready to take action. It appeared most of them didn’t want to give the others a chance to take what they came for.
However, far from the city gates, Pill Saint Barton and six others could be seen standing in wait for Kent too.
These six people were all mysterious, considering their faces were covered and their auras were suppressed to the point that sensing their cultivation base would be a problem.
"He is almost here," Pill Saint Barton said. "Wait until the formation is activated before taking action. The other Saints will also take action, but we mustn’t let his body fall into their hands."
"We won’t allow that, so rest assured, Pill Saint," one of the six figures said.
"Very well. The moment the battle is over, as promised, I will give you the Tier 7 pills and even throw in a Battle Doll."
The six figures nodded, and then their focus turned toward the city gate where Kent had just walked out, smiling.
After he walked through the gate, he stopped and looked toward the direction of the Evil Sect.
"Looks like you idiots came for revenge." He wasn’t even finished when a red energy beam shot from one direction and landed before him, exploding the ground.
Kent blinked away before the explosion.
But the moment the dust cleared, the skinny, bony figure who was the Grand Sect Leader of the Evil Sect appeared in the air, holding his twisted staff.
"Hand over your life." His staff shot a beam toward the sky, activating the formation that had been set up beforehand.
It activated, creating a dome that covered a 34-kilometer radius.
The moment it did, people started appearing inside.

The Assassins appeared, Pill Saint Barton and his men appeared, some random figures also appeared, and even Kent saw the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect elder who had come with two others the last time to take back Val after she became Kent’s servant..
Many others showed up, showing just how greedy people could be.
Kent just stared at the formation and smirked.
"I don’t know how many are still hiding. Not that I care. I just want to inform you all that since you chose to come against me, why don’t we play a game?"
His voice was full of sarcasm despite the formation meant to suppress his soul. Suddenly, lightning flashed in the sky.
"Here I come!"
Kaizo shouted as a powerful punch landed on the formation, shattering it completely. The Grand Sect Leader coughed up blood, showing just how deeply connected he was to the formation.
It was the formation he had sacrificed thousands of lives to create. The Soul Suppression Formation. It was meant to affect Kent’s soul, but it seemed...
"Nice entrance, Kaizo," Kent said to his first undead, causing the brute to smile.
"Thanks, Master." Kaizo looked at the faces of all those gathered and grinned. "Are these the fish we’ll be playing with?"
"Indeed. They thought they had everything under control." Kent smiled, taking out an item from his space ring.
A couple of people took a step back when they saw the item. Kent shook his head, watching this.
"Just like most of you have been looking forward to today’s battle, I was too. This is why I have created the perfect game for everyone."
He channeled his energy into the item, causing it to fly up. The moment it entered the clouds, a powerful energy burst out from it.
Then, from the sky, small stars started raining down on everyone. It took just a few seconds for the stars to land on everyone, even those hidden.
A few tried to dodge or destroy them, but they couldn’t.
"I prepared well for this moment, for I will be leaving when all of you are dead," Kent said as his sword appeared in his grip.
"This is why you should try to kill me, because until I am dead, nobody can leave this formation." Kent laughed as he floated up.
"Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to No Man’s Land." He snapped his fingers, and the terrain within a ten-mile radius changed into a battleground, pulling everyone in.
At the same time, space cracked, and Verydris, alongside thirteen Metal Battle Dolls, appeared. Kent bought the rest.
Now, he has 14 Metal Battle Dolls.
"Shall we?" Kent smiled as the space cracked behind the Grand Sect Leader, sending out a powerful sword arc—one of the many he had prepared twelve hours ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Kent Vs The Four Kingdoms (3)
paragraphs: Space cracked, and the sword arc flashed out, causing the skinny Grand Sect Leader to swing his staff back, pushing him several kilometers away.
"And so it began."
Kent blinked and appeared a few meters from the Grand Sect Leader. He was about to attack when a dagger appeared from behind him, threatening to sever his head from his body.
However, a claw painted in red pierced through the attacker’s chest, showing that Sylara, the evil undead, had arrived.
Kent didn’t even look behind him and focused on the Peak Sovereign now rising from the ground.
His sword swung forward, sending out 450 sword arcs. They rained down on the skinny figure. However, instead of getting hurt, he just stood there, looking coldly at Kent.
At that same moment, a figure appeared on Kent’s left and another on his right. Both were level 8 Sovereigns, each exuding a powerful aura.
"Grand Elder Ruolan, hand this brat over to me, and let me take care of him. I promise you will get what you came for." he fiure that appeared on Kent’s left spoke.
Many call him the Hunter, one of the deadliest killers known across the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. He was one of Pill Saint Barton’s men.
They said he had established his mercenary force in the ancient battlefield of Parting, cementing himself as a force that could not be reckoned with.
"Why don’t you give it to my Middle Finger Assassin Guild to handle?" the leader of the assassins hired by the Hand proposed.
He was also known by many for his skill in killing. They called him Haunting Shadows, for he haunted his victims before killing them.

Both recognized Ruolan’s superiority, considering they were only level 8, while Grand Elder Ruolan was level 9. But aside from that, they also knew fighting over Kent with him would invite doom upon themselves.
They are afraid of the skinny figure. This made Kent wonder just what they are scared of. But he just remained quiet, considering his third undead was around.
"How about you two come with him? My master needs to exercise." Kent smiled as his third undead, Vaelros, spoke, accompanied by two chains latching onto the Hunter and Haunting Shadows.
He pulled them away and then activated a domain skill.
"Chains of Torment."
The 12-kilometer radius was enclosed in a domain of chains, trapping Vaelros and the two level 8 Sovereigns.
"Have fun, Master," Vaelros’s voice said from within the Chains of Torment, widening Kent’s smile even further.
"Fun I shall have." Kent smiled.
He moved, but before he could get within three meters of Grand Elder Ruolan, a terrifying coffin appeared behind the skinny evil man, forcing out three corpses that lurched toward Kent.
He halted his steps and unleashed Rapid Slash, sending out 450 sword arcs. However, Grand Elder Ruolan quickly created a defense, saving the three corpses.
He stood atop his coffin, moving through the air as the three corpses attacked Kent from all sides.
⟪Looks like you found yourself in a sticky one today, Master⟫ Gaia’s voice entered Kent’s head as he deflected an attack from one of the corpses.
Each was a Sovereign-stage puppet—a level 3 Sovereign, all three corpse puppets. Kent didn’t reply because he was moving swiftly, creating openings to draw the corpses in.
Soon, one fell into his trap, prompting Kent to use the Fractured Void skill to unleash another sword arc. The arc cleaved through the corpse’s chest, killing it.
However, the moment the corpse died, it vanished back into the coffin.
⟪Killing the corpses won’t solve the problem, Master⟫, Gaia said with a giggle.
"No shit, Sherlock. I can clearly see that now," Kent smirked, knowing this would be one annoying battle.

⟪The only way to kill this evil person is to first destroy the coffin and then kill him. If you kill him before destroying the coffin, the chances of him getting resurrected are high. So, coffin first, then death⟫
Kent took mental note as his sword stabbed through yet another corpse.
However, before he could attack the second one, a bony hand came from his left, landing a powerful blow on his shoulder and sending him flying back.
"Die!" Grand Elder Ruolan shouted as he swung his staff in the air, causing dozens of small dark portals to appear, shooting out dark shards made of blood at Kent.
Kent created a dome around himself, deflecting the shards, but before he could move, a corpse that lung at him from the ground tried to latch onto his leg.
He dodged to the side and unleashed a powerful sword attack, forcing the skinny man to defend. Kent smirked as his eyes shone, simultaneously cracking the space behind the skinny man.
Another powerful sword arc flashed out, aiming for the coffin. However, a new corpse appeared and used its life to shield the coffin.
It’s hard to call it a life, considering it’s a corpse, but that didn’t change a thing; the corpse saved the coffin, buying the skinny man another chance to keep it.
But he became alert now, making Kent’s smile widen.
"No need to protect that. Either send it away and face me like a man or bring the corpses out and fight it out. Either way, your sect members are getting slaughtered."
Grand Elder Ruolan looked to his side, where he saw Selene sever the head of one of his sect elders.
The ladies had finished their business inside the city, so they joined the battle, using the lives of these pitiful people as practice.
The only ones in serious combat were Ingrid and Neomi. Each was taking on a Sovereign, despite Ingrid being a level 8 Root Great Sage and Neomi sitting at level 4 Transcendent.
The rest were just killing the weaker foes, with Mara bombarding Pill Saint Barton, who wasn’t getting any breathing space, considering he was fighting a level 1 Root Ascension cultivator.
Mara and Camilla had broken through to the Ascension stage, thanks to Kent. Val had also broken through to the Transcendent stage.
So, they all came prepared, ready to handle the battle with ease. Thankfully, Verydris was around to ensure they didn’t get ahead of themselves.
It’s safe to say the battle was in Kent’s favor... so far.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: Kent Vs The Four Kingdoms (4)
paragraphs: Pill Saint Barton lost one eye, and his chest was open thanks to Mara’s sword.
He had indeed fallen into a deep one this time. Among all of Kent’s women, he found himself facing Mara of all people.
Her legend is known by many.
Many call her a hater of men for she had never killed a woman before. Naturally, she hated men, so her trial of bodies are men.
Many know her as the Sword Dancer, for she moves like she is dancing, and she is really good at close combat using weapons.
She mostly prefers close combat, and it is one of the many reasons she is known by all.
Of course, nobody knew her true identity to be the infamous Dancer who once graced the sight of many men with her seductive dance moves.
It’s said that when she is in combat, just her moves alone can mesmerize her opponent, for she moves with the wind, and her body is connected to her sword, making every moment a sight to behold.
Now, the pitiful Pill Saint, whose plan was to set the six individuals he came with on Kent and then move back, was being forced to fight.
He never expected the formation set by the Evil Sect and the Middle Finger Assassin Guild to be destroyed so quickly.
But aside from that, he never expected Kent to unleash his own formation, one that could not be escaped.
One has to say his greed got him into this situation.
The other Pill Saints only sent their men to come after Kent while they stayed far from the battlefield. This saved them from getting trapped in the formation.
But his ambitions and greed made him fall into Kent’s trap.
Now, he was blaming himself for being greedy, knowing his chances of escaping death were next to none.
With every blow that landed on him, he could only recall what Kent had said: If they came against him, they would die.
"Why are you doing this, Gate Master? I’ve done nothing against your sect, so why come against me?" Pill Saint Barton said, spitting blood as more came from his nose.
"That’s the thing, Pill Saint. You really did nothing against my sect. However, you came after a disciple from my sect, and this disciple happens to be my man.
So, while killing you will be a loss to the four kingdoms, I can’t have you coming after him again. So you must die," Mara said with a cold smile.
"Now hand me your life." She moved again, swinging her sword at Pill Saint Barton, who just couldn’t understand why his attacks weren’t working.
Of course, his soul attacks weren’t working.
Elsa made sure the souls of her sisters were protected so that all forms of soul attacks wouldn’t affect them. It’s not complete immunity, considering she can only do that for Kent and three others.
The more she grows, the higher this number will rise. But aside from Kent, Lilian, Unity, and Selene, the rest of her sisters have 70% immunity to all soul attacks.
But thanks to Akira, they now have a necklace that protects their souls against even Tier 10 soul attacks.
So all his soul attacks weren’t doing anything to the determined lady who wanted to hand the pitiful saint’s head to her husband.
Pill Saint Barton is fucked for life.
Meanwhile, Kaizo has already finished smashing a couple of heads and is now locked in combat with a Level 2 Sovereign who looks like a body cultivator.
They are creating powerful shockwaves all around, giving them a rather large battlefield. Kaizo was having the best time of his life.
However, one could tell he was putting his all into it. His focus wasn’t entirely on the brute he was fighting with.
Kent and Grand Elder Ruolan are also at it, with Kent not even showing a sign of fear or tiredness. Instead, his eyes are filled with determination.
He had already destroyed close to fifteen corpse puppets.
"Fractured Void."

Kent used the Sword Gaze skill, causing a large crack to appear behind the skinny man again, but instead of a sword arc coming out, a crescent-shaped arc flashed out just in time for Kent to unleash 450 sword arcs.
Grand Elder Ruolan moved back, but before he could put away the coffin, considering the sword attacks were coming for it, a powerful punch came from one side, shattering it completely.
"Nice one, Kaizo," Kent smiled.
He had been trying to destroy the coffin for a while now, but the skinny man wasn’t creating any openings for him. So, he devised the next best move: to let Kaizo handle it.
"Now that your coffin is gone, you can die," Kent said with a smile. He vanished and appeared behind Grand Elder Ruolan, swinging his sword at his leg.
But, Ruolan evaded, moving back. It was a close call, but he evaded it. Of course, Kent was disappointed at this outcome.
Kent, who has memories of his past life as Jest, now possesses all the skills known to the point he had remembered to.
His finger trailed along the blade of his sword, causing it to crackle with lightning.

"Blinding Slash." His sword traced a blinding arc across the landscape and exploded on the body of the now tired and shaken Peak Sovereign, who just couldn’t tell how a mere Great Sage was able to handle all his deadly attacks.
Kent wasn’t even hurt.

Of course, this was thanks to his life inside the Sword Valley back in his life as Jest. Back then, facing harrowing dangers, he had developed a sixth sense that allowed him to sense anything coming for his life.
So he unleashed yet another blinding slash, one of Jest’s signature moves.
Grand Elder Ruolan felt his body overwhelmed by the paralyzing effect of Kent’s lightning.
Kent moved and appeared behind him again, unleashing yet another attack.

This time, his sword landed on Grand Elder Ruolan’s body, but shockingly, it left no mark. Still, Kent didn’t give up. He certainly didn’t want to spare the evil man, who was now bleeding from his nose.
Bang.
Suddenly, the entire battlefield shook, causing cracks to appear in the formation.
"They’re finally here." Kent smiled and stopped moving.
"Time for you to die." He sheathed his sword and raised his thin hand.
"And there shall be darkness," Kent said, unleashing the [Edge of the Night] skill and creating a domain of darkness around Grand Elder Ruolan.
This allowed him to unleash yet another sword arc from the void. This landed quite well on Grand Elder Ruolan’s body, sending him flying.
After he had recovered, he locked eyes with Kent. The brat smirks and unleashes another attack.
"Hand me your soul." The command was simple, but Grand Elder Ruolan felt something piercing stab through his soul, causing him to cough up blood.
He had a soul defense treasure that prevented him from dying instantly.
Kent sensed this, smiled, and flicked his finger, causing the void to crack. Grand Elder Ruolan turned and looked, ready to defend against another sword arc.
However, he only saw a red eye that snapped open, meeting his gaze. When the eye opened, he fell from the sky, landing heavily on the ground.
The Soul-Rending Glare cannot be defended against easily. So he fell to his death, and a second later, his body was claimed by Kent, who couldn’t allow a Sovereign’s body to go to waste.
He turned to his women and army, causing a smile to appear on his face.
"The big leagues are here, so why don’t we wrap things up here?

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Kent Vs The Four Kingdoms (5)
paragraphs: Kent’s main objective for facing Grand Elder Ruolan wasn’t to see if he could confront a sovereign.
No, he had already reached a level that gave him the confidence to face even multiple Peak Sovereigns and walk away smiling.
This confidence came from what happened the day before the battle.
When he left for the Pill Master Competition, his ladies gathered and held a meeting. In this meeting, they each shared their views on how best to support their man.
Naturally, it boiled down to sex.
However, Alina raised a point that made them all aware of something.
They realized that while sex allowed their man to grow, he didn’t depend solely on that. The points he gained whenever they leveled up or broke through were equally valuable.
They concluded that, aside from relying on sex to level up, they would actively cultivate too.
Whenever he is not around or there is no stronger woman around to increase Kent’s cultivation base, they will get down to good old traditional cultivation.
So, thanks to the time difference inside the tower, they got down to business.
Only a few days passed for Kent, but for them, months passed, and these months were spent cultivating.
Naturally, their hard work paid off when Unity, Lilian, Elsa, Alina, Val, Ingrid, Neomi, and Selene leveled up.
Val, Ingrid, Neomi and Selene are already Transcendents, so their level-up gave Kent thousands of points.
This gave Kent many points, which he added to his stats.
However, something happened after he had distributed about 70% of the undistributed stats points.
Gaia told him a couple of weeks ago about something called maximization.

It occurs when his stats can’t handle any more points, requiring him to break that limit and add more. The moment he managed to break that limit, his strength would enter a new phase he couldn’t comprehend.
So when that happened, Kent entered the Body Tower.
It was a choice between cultivating his soul or body.
Naturally, it had been a long time since he entered the Body Tower, considering that after his sword body and body cultivation had merged, he attained a Silver Body.
This meant that to break the limit, he had to become a Gold Body cultivator.
What he never expected was what happened after that.
Thanks to reaching the maximisation level, his strength was on a new plane. This gave him the confidence to climb the stairway to levels he never thought possible.
When he received the Golden Titan Stairway, Gaia told him that it was divided into seven segments, each containing about 300 steps.
She also told him that after he had climbed 300 steps, he would receive a mystical-grade tempering treasure.
But while that was the main goal, for every 100 steps climbed, he would receive a Heaven-grade tempering treasure. There are some other technicalities, but so far, these two are the main ones.
Naturally, Kent didn’t dwell on that too much.
However, when he reached the first 100 steps, he was given a liquid treasure called Bone Tempering Elixir. Kent didn’t pay much attention to it.
But the moment he drank it, the outcome became clear. His bones were tempered, and he could tell something extraordinary had happened when it was done.
He felt like his bones had transcended a limit he wasn’t aware of.
Gaia only giggled when he asked her, so Kent continued to climb and soon reached the 200th step.
If only he knew the Elixir he had just drank was something that started turning his bones into something he would only appreciate when he reached the Immortal Body stage.
When he reached the 200th step, he received the Bone Tempering Elixir again.
Naturally, he didn’t expect anything new, considering the first and second grades were the same. But after drinking it, he realized the Golden Titan Stairway was a gold mine.
His strength kept rising to the point he felt that a punch from Evil Bat, from when he and Kaizo faced him, wouldn’t do any damage anymore.
He also felt his speed enhanced, meaning he had entered a new phase in the path of body cultivation.
This was why he tried so hard to keep going, and after five days inside the tower, he barely made it to the 300th step.
But he did, and when his reward came and he appraised it, he nearly dropped it.
The treasure wasn’t one he saw coming, and he didn’t expect it at this early stage. In his memories as Jest, he once went to an auction where it was auctioned.
It was a great bidding war that went outside the auction house, causing the death of hundreds.
It was called the Body Transcendence Pill, which is of great value to any cultivator, but it’s even more valuable to a body cultivator.
Of course, Kent expected many things but never anticipated getting a Tier 9 perfect pill after climbing the 300th step.
He took it eagerly and continued to absorb it for another five days until his breakthrough came on the 11th day after entering the Body Tower.
He reached the Gold Body stage, breaking his limit and allowing him to allocate the rest of his points.
In fact, after becoming a Gold Body cultivator, his Sword Body also advanced, which enhanced his swordsmanship.
Kent never expected that.
Even Gaia, who created the Tower, didn’t anticipate it. It was a shock to both of them.
Thankfully, the brilliant Dori managed to deduce the reason.
She mainly attributed it to a mutation. Body Cultivation, Soul Cultivation, and Qi Cultivation aren’t typically practiced by a single person.
In fact, it’s rare. But Kent wasn’t the first to tread this path.
However, what made this special was the Sword Body he had integrated.
This created something akin to a channel now open to other aspects, like the Soul Body, the Perfect Qi Body, and others he will get to discover on his path to the peak.
His Sword Body ensured that his breakthrough influenced his other aspects whenever he achieved a breakthrough in Body Cultivation.
Thus, his soul, swordsmanship, and even his Qi were affected when he became a Gold Body cultivator.
Kent didn’t realize just how formidable he had become. He gained so much that he never knew a Peak Sovereign wouldn’t scare him anymore.
Of course, he realised that when he faced the Peak Sovereign. It was then he understood he had surpassed that stage.
He only fought the Sovereign to gauge how powerful he had become, and truthfully, he was astonished.
Now, watching his ladies and the undead battle his enemies, he couldn’t help but wonder what had transpired during those few days in the Body Tower.
"If this continues for another maximization, not even the Forest Kings could stand against me. This makes me want to fight one now."
Kent laughed as he saw Mara sever Pill Saint Barton’s head. It was a clean cut that made him smile through his laughter.

The ladies are each killing their fair share of their foes, making Kent smile while watching them. This harem is rather wield, considering his ladies are bloodthirsty fiends who didn’t even bat an eye killing their fellow humans.
But who could blame them? Between their man and these people, not even a god could save them.
But then another attack struck the formation, making Kent smirk.

chapters.title: Chapter 458: Kent Vs The Four Kingdoms (6)
paragraphs: "That is the last of them, Master," Sylara said to Kent, licking her lips. It wasn’t her being seductive. Even her tongue is a deal-breaker.
Looking at the blood drooling from the corner of her mouth, it was plain by day that the five Sovereigns she alone had killed had now become her blood bank for the time being.
The bodies would be given to Kent after she had drained them.
But watching the terrifying one-eyed lady licking her lips, Unity couldn’t help tugging on Kent’s sleeve, showing she was scared.
Kent just smiled and hugged her while making sure Sylara knew she was scaring his innocent wife who, against all odds, fought side by side with her overpowered sisters.
Vaelros also came, looking like he had eaten a snack. Naturally, Kent knew the heart that used to belong to Hunter, and the Haunting Shadows were now in his stomach.
The two undead aside, Kaizo were all carnivores. They liked blood, and Vaelros even ate them. Not that Kent cared too much about that.
He himself was all about collecting dead bodies for his unholy projects.
They all had their kinks, I guess.
Kent laughed and looked at Veydris and the thirteen Metal Battle Dolls.
Veydris was their leader, and while Kent didn’t know how he gave them commands, considering the overpowered knight didn’t talk, the battle went smoothly because of him and the thirteen dolls.
But now, the scene had changed, and Kent was about to face the music.
"So this is where it ends for us, huh?" Neomi asked, still in her Vak’Shara form. This form was for slaughter.
It was designed to kill, for that was the form Shara created when she entered the trial of ten thousand people and came out as the sole survivor.
She had killed over seven thousand people in that trial, something that molded her into someone even death obeyed.
But now, she couldn’t help but ask.
Bang!
Another blow landed on the formation when Kent was about to answer.
"This is indeed where the battle ends for you ladies. But don’t worry, we have missions to get back to, many missions both in this world and beyond.
You must return to the tower and wait for your big sister.
The pawns in this battle are here, and while I would love to cut off the heads of the lions, they will do for now." He smiled at the clearly unwilling faces.
"Don’t worry. The real battle will happen soon enough. When that time came, even the gods would be scared if they were to witness."
"Very well. But don’t hesitate to summon us when the battle is beyond you. Remember, we are your strength just as you are ours."
"I will do well to remember that, love." Kent planted a kiss on each of his women before sending them back to the tower.
Only he, his undead, Veydris, Nara, and Lady Lani remained.
"You ladies must also go for now. Nara, take care of your friend, for her first time must be special." Kent smiled and leaned in, planting a kiss on Nara’s cheek before sending her away blushing.
"You are about to learn something new about me. Just ask the ladies all the questions on your mind and, well, wait for me to come and take care of you."
Lady Lani didn’t know what was happening, but when she felt Kent knead her butt and whisper in her ear, her cheeks turned beet red.
"Prepare and wait for me, my little assassin." That was what she heard before she appeared inside a lush garden filled with some of the most valuable fruits one could ask for.
Her cheeks were red like a ripped tomato. Alina had to step in since she is the most familiar with her.
But the terrifying assassin is now inside the tower, meaning there is no going back for her.
Meanwhile, inside the formation, Kent looked at the four figures before him with a smirk.
"Are you guys ready?" he asked, and Kaizo, being Kaizo, beat his chest, showing he was still hungry for battle.
"Very well, let’s go out with a bang." Kent smiled, and Veydris vanished back into the void.
The three undead stood behind him, and then he deactivated the formation, revealing to all those gathered and watching the horror that had happened inside the formation, which also acted as a domain.
"Kent Madson, under the authority of the four kings of the four kingdoms, you are hereby commanded to surrender and appear before a tribunal where you will be tried and punished for your crimes."
A man in a set of armor shouted the moment Kent appeared. He was a peak Sovereign, and judging by his aura, he was several times stronger than Grand Elder Ruolan.
Standing behind him were six others also wearing the same armor, all at the peak of the Sovereign stage. Of course, he could sense a few others just out of sight.
But Kent just looked at them and scoffed.
"May I know what crimes I have committed?" Kent asked.

"You have murdered three of the finest blacksmiths in the four kingdoms, murdered two Pill Saints, killed thousands of powerful cultivators the kingdoms rely on, and even went as far as to purchase forbidden items meant to bring division to the four kingdoms.
These, among other things, are crimes that cannot be forgiven."
"First of all, I didn’t murder them, I just killed them."
The ladies watching this inside the tower, thanks to Gaia, laughed. Whether killing or murdering, at the end of the day, the people were dead, so what was the difference?
"This brat, he just doesn’t know when to get serious." Mara smiled, knowing she was forever tied to this brat despite his unique qualities.
"Second, those I killed deserved it. It wasn’t like I just woke up and chose to kill them. They came against me, and I had to defend myself.
So tell me, sir, was I supposed to lower my head and let them kill me instead?"
"You killed important people the four kingdoms hold in high esteem, so you must surrender, or force will be applied."
"Force will be applied... Hahaha," Kent laughed. "Just where is that confidence coming from?"
"Oh, I see." Kent turned his gaze toward the clouds.
"Protector Navarro and Protector Han, since you are here to do the work of your masters, why don’t you join us? Or are you perhaps looking down on me?"
The half-mask that covered his eyes down to his nose appeared on Kent’s face, along with his sword, the moment he said that.
Naturally, the disrespect wasn’t something the two kingdom protectors saw coming. Kent, of course, expected worse, for just then, a voice entered his ears.
"Kent, run. I can only hold one of them back."
It was Kingdom Protector Vari’s voice. She was locked in with one of the kingdom’s protectors, making the two of them slip away.
But Kent, of course, wouldn’t run, not when a mega quest was on the line.
He looked toward the clouds, and like the Earthling he was, he raised his hand and thumbed down to the two kings.
"Or are the infamous Kingdom Protectors scared of a mere Great Sage?"
BOOM.
A powerful aura descended from the clouds.
And so they appeared.

sentences.text: "That is the last of them, Master," Sylara said to Kent, licking her lips.
It wasn’t her being seductive.
Even her tongue is a deal-breaker.
Looking at the blood drooling from the corner of her mouth, it was plain by day that the five Sovereigns she alone had killed had now become her blood bank for the time being.
The bodies would be given to Kent after she had drained them.
But watching the terrifying one-eyed lady licking her lips, Unity couldn’t help tugging on Kent’s sleeve, showing she was scared.
Kent just smiled and hugged her while making sure Sylara knew she was scaring his innocent wife who, against all odds, fought side by side with her overpowered sisters.
Vaelros also came, looking like he had eaten a snack.
Naturally, Kent knew the heart that used to belong to Hunter, and the Haunting Shadows were now in his stomach.
The two undead aside, Kaizo were all carnivores.
They liked blood, and Vaelros even ate them.
Not that Kent cared too much about that.
He himself was all about collecting dead bodies for his unholy projects.
They all had their kinks, I guess.
Kent laughed and looked at Veydris and the thirteen Metal Battle Dolls.
Veydris was their leader, and while Kent didn’t know how he gave them commands, considering the overpowered knight didn’t talk, the battle went smoothly because of him and the thirteen dolls.
But now, the scene had changed, and Kent was about to face the music.
"So this is where it ends for us, huh?" Neomi asked, still in her Vak’Shara form.
This form was for slaughter.
It was designed to kill, for that was the form Shara created when she entered the trial of ten thousand people and came out as the sole survivor.
She had killed over seven thousand people in that trial, something that molded her into someone even death obeyed.
But now, she couldn’t help but ask.
Bang!
Another blow landed on the formation when Kent was about to answer.
"This is indeed where the battle ends for you ladies.
But don’t worry, we have missions to get back to, many missions both in this world and beyond.
You must return to the tower and wait for your big sister.
The pawns in this battle are here, and while I would love to cut off the heads of the lions, they will do for now." He smiled at the clearly unwilling faces.
"Don’t worry.
The real battle will happen soon enough.
When that time came, even the gods would be scared if they were to witness."
"Very well.
But don’t hesitate to summon us when the battle is beyond you.
Remember, we are your strength just as you are ours."
"I will do well to remember that, love." Kent planted a kiss on each of his women before sending them back to the tower.
Only he, his undead, Veydris, Nara, and Lady Lani remained.
"You ladies must also go for now.
Nara, take care of your friend, for her first time must be special." Kent smiled and leaned in, planting a kiss on Nara’s cheek before sending her away blushing.
"You are about to learn something new about me.
Just ask the ladies all the questions on your mind and, well, wait for me to come and take care of you."
Lady Lani didn’t know what was happening, but when she felt Kent knead her butt and whisper in her ear, her cheeks turned beet red.
"Prepare and wait for me, my little assassin." That was what she heard before she appeared inside a lush garden filled with some of the most valuable fruits one could ask for.
Her cheeks were red like a ripped tomato.
Alina had to step in since she is the most familiar with her.
But the terrifying assassin is now inside the tower, meaning there is no going back for her.
Meanwhile, inside the formation, Kent looked at the four figures before him with a smirk.
"Are you guys ready?" he asked, and Kaizo, being Kaizo, beat his chest, showing he was still hungry for battle.
"Very well, let’s go out with a bang." Kent smiled, and Veydris vanished back into the void.
The three undead stood behind him, and then he deactivated the formation, revealing to all those gathered and watching the horror that had happened inside the formation, which also acted as a domain.
"Kent Madson, under the authority of the four kings of the four kingdoms, you are hereby commanded to surrender and appear before a tribunal where you will be tried and punished for your crimes."
A man in a set of armor shouted the moment Kent appeared.
He was a peak Sovereign, and judging by his aura, he was several times stronger than Grand Elder Ruolan.
Standing behind him were six others also wearing the same armor, all at the peak of the Sovereign stage.
Of course, he could sense a few others just out of sight.
But Kent just looked at them and scoffed.
"May I know what crimes I have committed?" Kent asked.

"You have murdered three of the finest blacksmiths in the four kingdoms, murdered two Pill Saints, killed thousands of powerful cultivators the kingdoms rely on, and even went as far as to purchase forbidden items meant to bring division to the four kingdoms.
These, among other things, are crimes that cannot be forgiven."
"First of all, I didn’t murder them, I just killed them."
The ladies watching this inside the tower, thanks to Gaia, laughed.
Whether killing or murdering, at the end of the day, the people were dead, so what was the difference?
"This brat, he just doesn’t know when to get serious." Mara smiled, knowing she was forever tied to this brat despite his unique qualities.
"Second, those I killed deserved it.
It wasn’t like I just woke up and chose to kill them.
They came against me, and I had to defend myself.
So tell me, sir, was I supposed to lower my head and let them kill me instead?"

Hahaha," Kent laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 459: Kent Vs The Four Kingdoms (7)
paragraphs: When Kent said those last words, two powerful presences descended upon the space, causing all those watching from the sidelines to move several steps back.
Two Kingdom Protectors, each a powerhouse, had descended into battle following Kent’s clear disrespect and decisive action.
Two men who looked like they were in their late fifties appeared in the sky, staring daggers at Kent.
One had brown hair, and the other had dark hair.
The dark-haired man is the protector of the Eldorath Kingdom.
He is called Navarro, a Spearman who had entered the Spear King stage and was only a few steps away from attaining the infamous title of Spear Emperor.
The other is Han, the protector from Varyndor kings.

According to popular knowledge, he is a powerful combat mage who was the first human to reach the Core Formation stage. Of course, he isn’t the strongest but was first to become a Core formation expert.
These two powerful individuals were now staring at Kent with furious eyes.
"You would do well to surrender rather than make things difficult for yourself," Protector Navarro said, causing Kent to burst into uncontrollable laughter.
"What if I said no? Then what are you going to do?" Kent asked.
The two protectors turned their gaze toward each other, and for a moment, the will to kill could be sensed from them.
"Let me make this plain as day to you two," Kent said. "I know you’re here because the true evil behind this is just too scared to show up.
But that’s also good. I wouldn’t want to commit a massacre yet. That wouldn’t be good for what’s on the way.
However, while I don’t plan on committing a massacre, I have to kill some things. Thankfully, you idiots are here. As Kingdom Protectors, why choose to become someone’s errand boy?
Is that how low you see yourselves, or do you just not have the will to handle matters yourself? Either way, I am disappointed in you two.
So here’s what’s going to happen.
All Sovereigns currently coming against me will die, and when I said they would, I meant every last word in that statement.
But as much as I’d love to brag, I’ve only made plans to kill one of you Protectors. So you can choose which among you is ripe for killing.
Either way, one of you will die, and the other will lose a leg or an arm. It depends."
His smile showed he wasn’t scared one bit.
This made the two Core Formation experts—who shouldn’t feel fear—suddenly feel it. They didn’t know why, but the fear gripped them deep within.

However, after glancing at the people behind Kent and then back at him, they shook off the fear. Sylara, Vaelros, and Kaizo might look intimidating, but they weren’t at a level that warranted true fear.
"Kill them," Protector Han ordered, prompting the armored Peak Sovereigns to lunge at Kent and his team. In response, Kaizo, Sylara, and Vaelros sprang into action.
"Chains of Torment!" Vaelros unleashed his domain, trapping four Sovereigns within it.
"Abyssal Realm of Torture." Sylara followed, casting her domain skill and ensnaring the other three.
Meanwhile, Kaizo dashed past the two and struck an empty space.
It looked weird at first; however, when he landed the blow, it revealed a hidden figure—someone cloaked and wielding a dagger was punched out, landing heavily on the ground.
"Don’t try to play hide and seek with me, punk," Kaizo said, eyes narrowing at the woman retreating.
A smile crept across his face as lightning armor crackled over his body, and a gauntlet formed around his fist.
His speed exploded as he closed in and landed another blow, sending the assassin lady back.
Inside the tower.
"This bitch... so she’s on their side," Lady Lani cursed, gripping the dagger that appeared in her hand the moment she saw the familiar face.
"Who is she, big sister?" Alina asked.
"She’s the leader of the expedition I was planning a month after the sect competition," Lady Lani answered.
"Looks like you’ll need to choose a new leader now, big sister," Alina said with a smirk, watching the fury on Lani’s face. It was clear she hadn’t seen this betrayal coming.
"If Kent doesn’t kill her, I’ll do it myself."
Back on the battlefield, Kent continued staring at the Protectors, who seemed to be waiting for something.
They seemed relaxed at first, but after five minutes passed, and nothing happened. Their expressions grew tense as they started to glance around.
"Let me guess—you’re wondering what happened to the three assassins you had hidden," Kent said with a smirk, causing the two Protectors to narrow their eyes.
"Veydris, drop them."
At Kent’s command, two headless bodies dropped from the clouds, followed by a third body—stabbed through the chest—still hanging on Veydris’s colossal sword.
"Oops. Looks like we’ve got a hanging issue on our hands," Kent laughed.
"Die!" Protector Han couldn’t take it anymore and lunged at Kent with his staff. His speed was explosive, closing the gap between him and Kent instantly.
However, just as a spell began to form at the tip of the staff—which had transformed into a lance—a voice echoed through the space, followed by a gentle tap at the tip of the weapon.
"Death is a rather harsh word to say to my master, don’t you think?"
A figure with skin so pale it seemed devoid of color appeared right before the still-smiling Kent and calmly tapped the spear’s tip, now only a meter from Kent’s face.
With a simple flick of his finger, the figure sent Han flying back.

"Good to see you’ve finally decided to grace us with your presence, Zareth," Kent said, calling out his fourth undead, who had been hiding throughout the battle, waiting for what he considered a worthy opponent.
"Although he is not worthy to face me, I can’t just watch you die," Zareth replied with a small smile.
Looking at him, Kent could tell he is a little different from Kaizo and co.
He looks more undead and, strangely, more like someone who had lived through many things, unlike Kaizo and the others who came with blank slates.

"Tsk... Just make sure he dies before I’m done severing that one’s arm. You wouldn’t want me punishing you," Kent said, glancing at Protector Navarro, who now looked alarmed at the new figure standing beside Kent.
If Kaizo and the rest don’t scare him, this black-and-white figure sure looks scary.
"Try not to die, Master." Zareth, who was at the Peak of the Sovereign storage stage, said with a smile.
He was Kent’s first True Undead, considering he had awakened a true name, looked at the protector Navarro with pity before he vanished, and reappeared just a meter away from Protector Han.
"Why don’t we take this somewhere else?" A whip-like chain materialized in Zareth’s hand, and with a swift swing...
"Draconic-Serpent Domain."
The space cracked and warped, enveloping the two of them in an isolated domain where their battle would occur.
Meanwhile, Kent turned to Protector Navarro and smiled.
"Shall we?"
The void behind Protector Navarro shattered, and hundreds of sword arcs burst out, raining down on him. Kent lunged forward at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: Kent Vs Protector Navarro (1)
paragraphs: The sword arcs kept raining down from the void, forcing Protector Navarro to parry and unleash spear swings to defend against them.
Every swing of his spear generated powerful shockwaves.
However, he was still struggling—though his reaction speed was far from ordinary.
After all, he wasn’t just a Core Formation expert sitting at Level 3; he was also a Spear Sage, someone Kent shouldn’t be fighting against.
He also possessed soul strength currently at the peak of Tier 10. So, in all aspects, he is better than Kent...
All of this wasn’t something Kent should be able to contend with. But Kent wasn’t like everyone else—he had already ensured his speed had reached a new height.
Plus, Kent was also a Gold Body cultivator, so surprise attacks wouldn’t catch him off guard.
One could say he has a thick skin.

So, while the Protector was defending against the sword arcs, Kent closed in and executed a series of rapid slashes, sending even more sword arcs at Protector Navarro, who spun his spear, creating a vortex of wind around him.
"Oh, but that won’t save you."
Kent used the Lunar Eclipse Strike skill, causing a crescent-shaped arc to flash out from thin air and strike the vortex.
This caused the vortex to dissipate.
However, the moment the vortex was destroyed, Kent couldn’t find Protector Navarro where he had been standing. This put him on high alert.
Suddenly, a figure appeared behind him, stabbing a spear toward his back. But Kent was prepared—he dodged to the side and swung his leg.
Protector Navarro raised his leg, blocking Kent’s kick.
He then swung his spear at Kent’s head, but the brat was too fast for that.
Kent ducked low, his body brushing the ground as the spear whooshed overhead. He twisted mid-roll, planted his hand, and flipped backward, narrowly avoiding a second strike aimed at his legs.
It was pure close combat at this point, with neither showing any signs of being overwhelmed.
Of course, this wasn’t what anyone expected—watching Kent fight someone four realms above him. It was like witnessing the most questionable thing, yet no one could question it.
Kent was indeed fighting a being considered the peak of this world, and he wasn’t struggling at all.
If only they knew—Kent wasn’t a mere Great Sage.

He had already surpassed that stage long before reaching the Maximization stage. Now, he had broken a limit within himself, and Kent sensed that he would soon take a much deeper dive into this Maximization.
It had pushed him to a stage where he could feel his movement reaching the initial stages of Core Formation even without using his dragon bloodline.
That was how terrifying he had become.
Protector Navarro could sense that, which was why he was doing everything he could to avoid being overwhelmed.

He initially thought he could easily handle Kent, considering he was just a level 8 Root Great Sage. But after facing him, he started to see why Kent chose to be arrogant when he could have chosen to escape when he had the chance.
That alone pissed him off. However, that wasn’t the only thing that pissed him off. He made the second discovery after exchanging a few blows with Kent.
’He wanted to use me to test his strength.’
That thought echoed in his mind—and it was true. Kent was making it difficult for him to even use any of his Legendary-grade skills.
He was testing just how strong he had become since Grand Elder Ruolan couldn’t help him.
This alone was plain disrespect. That was why he was no longer holding back. Killing Kent would give him that calm.
He chose not to give him a breather, which, unfortunately for him, didn’t do much against Kent.
He charged forward, thrusting his spear in a blur—three quick jabs aimed at Kent’s chest, shoulder, and thigh.
Kent was using all the knowledge he had absorbed from his past self and the three levels of the Sword Bridge he had cleared.
It’s safe to say he had reached a stage in close combat that many could only dream of.
He was deflecting, parrying, and dodging the spear thrusts coming in rapid succession.
Kent’s feet slid across the ground like a phantom’s. He could feel the spear qi in the air—it was as if it had been precisely coordinated to target only his vulnerable points.
But that wasn’t what Kent was worried about.
Somehow, he could tell he had no business fighting someone who was on the same level as a Sword King. That was just too much.
Protector Navarro is a Spear King who could easily kill him using his spear realm.
However, he hadn’t done so because he couldn’t use the Spear Realm—just like a Sword King couldn’t use the Sword Realm against someone who hadn’t formed one yet or hadn’t reached the king stage.
He can’t attack someone who doesn’t have a realm with your his own realm unless he wants the Heavenly Daos to rain their hatred upon you.
So, despite being out of his league, Kent knew this battle could be won using experience and skill—something he wasn’t lacking at the moment.
With a sudden burst of movement, Kent stepped inside the Protector’s guard, his blade humming as he slashed upward.
Navarro tilted his spear and blocked at the last moment, but the sheer force pushed him back several meters. Dust scattered beneath his boots.
"Edge of the Night."
"Lunar Eclipse Slash."
"Thousand Blade Reflection."
Kent activated three skills at once.
Protector Navarro was drowned in darkness, blinding him completely. Then, from straight ahead, an eye snapped open, unleashing a crescent arc that instantly split into a thousand reflections.
The rain came down on the Protector, who didn’t see it coming.
He raised his defenses, but they were shattered, allowing most of the attacks to land on his body, sending him flying nearly a mile back.

He slammed into a massive tree, destroying it completely. However, before he could gather himself, a dark shard made of the strongest mineral stabbed at his leg—grazing it, since he managed to dodge even the one aimed at his heart.
Of course, Kent knew he would be able to dodge. That was why he had prepared something else for the Protector, who was now beginning to sense the shift in battle.
Kent was gaining the upper hand, and while the Protector shouldn’t be struggling to defend against his skills, they were proving surprisingly dangerous.

He was getting back on his feet when his gaze landed on the thousand crescent arcs coming down at him. He knew the battle hadn’t even entered its final phase, but he was already being forced to get serious.
"Heaven Shattering Spear." So he decided to unleash his own skill.
The clouds parted as a colossal spear appeared, locking onto Kent. Since thousands of sword arcs were flying at him, it was only natural for Kent to face something of equal intensity.
So, Navarro poured his energy into the attack, causing the massive spear to descend.
However, instead of getting alarmed, Kent smiled.
"You shouldn’t have done that." His eyes glowed as he activated one of the seven skills he had learned during the Sword Gaze Enlightenment.
