chapters.title: Chapter 474: Making Preparations
paragraphs: "I will be leaving now," Kent said as he kissed Vexthra. "The connection will be created within six hours, so be ready. I will summon you over immediately it’s formed."
Vexthra nodded.
"So, what will it be like?" she asked.

"You will still be you. Your cultivation won’t be suppressed. I am even sure there will be divine energy in the air, meaning you can cultivate while there. Gaia also said you can remain there for as long as you want, provided I, the owner, have enough tower points."
Kent sighed, knowing he had been robbed when he desperately asked for help from the three Lolis. Every last Tower Point in his possession was taken.
Of course, he knew they had a good reason for taking it. But it still doesn’t taste nice in his mouth.
"Looks like you have some capable helpers, huh. I am jealous," Vexthra pouted, allowing Kent to play with her nipples.
"You can have them if you want, especially Gaia. That little brat actually stole all my tower points from me. I will punish her when I get back."
Vexthra giggled, watching his bittersweet expression.
"Just don’t make things hard on them. I can tell they will forever be a great help to you."
"I know. They are the best, just that they are spoiled too much. But I will straighten them up," he laughed.
"But don’t worry, although I am zero on tower points, you have a 30-day free stay. I will get some more points to keep you there much longer."
"You are the best," she said, kissing him.
"By the way, what will you do when you get there?" Kent asked, wanting to know something. However, Vexthra just smiled and said nothing.
If only he knew the mischief she was planning, perhaps he would keep her in the god realm for a while.
"Okay, I am leaving, or else they will kick me out," Kent said, watching the countdown on the Starbound Compass.
Vexthra handed him a space ring.

"While I don’t know how this summoning will be, I can’t bet everything on it, so take this item there for me since you have a way. Don’t look into it. If you do, I will know." She handed him a diamond space ring.
Kent didn’t even bother to look into it and quickly threw it into his Tower storage.
"Then see you in six hours," Kent said, opening the portal and walking in. The naked goddess rolled on her bed, smiling. A few minutes later, she dressed up and left her realm.
A few minutes later, after teleporting a few hundred times, she was in front of a temple. The entire outward coating is covered in green grass, making it appear more beautiful than expected.
"I am here to see you, Mother," Vexthra said, not daring to enter the temple until she was allowed in.
A second hadn’t even passed when she found herself standing before a bone-like throne, where a beautiful lady with dark hair falling down her back and touching the floor could be seen seated.
She had the perfect bone structure, and, well, one had to say if Vexthra was the most beautiful lady Kent had ever seen, then this lady was another world of beauty.
She is gorgeous, and the assets on her would make any man turn their head.

Both eyes were ocean blue, but one was filled with positive emotions while the other, much like Vexthra’s red eyes, was filled with all kinds of negative emotions, with hatred and resentment being the strongest.
"That was careless of you, Vexthra. How can you be this stupid?" the enchantress frowned as she spoke. Her gaze was both affectionate and furious at the same time.
"I told you everything from the book of stories and legend comes with a huge price, so why didn’t you stop when you came upon something very forbidden?"
"I am sorry, Mother. I just wanted to help him," Vexthra apologized, knowing she had made him blunder this time.
Of course, the enchantress hadn’t thought she would gain forbidden knowledge from those stories. If she knew, she would have stopped her from even reading a single page.
"You are lucky your man is capable. Even with all my powers, saving you would have been impossible," the enchantress sighed.
"My man is indeed capable," Vexthra shamelessly used Kent’s name to brag. This made the enchantress chuckle.
"Why are you here?" she asked, looking at the goddess from the corner of her eye. She was happy she was safe, but also knew Vexthra wouldn’t come to her if she didn’t need anything.
This means she is after something.

"Relax, I am not here for any more pages. I’ve learned my lesson," Vexthra laughed. "I am just here to inform you that I will descend to the mortal realm for the next couple of weeks, perhaps months, if possible, a year."
"Please don’t tell me you’ve found a way to evade the laws. You know they can be merciless, right?" the enchantress said, but Vexthra just smiled.

"Relax. The method is safe and secure. I just came to let you know before I leave. Also, keep an eye on my domain for me. I have a feeling those idiots from the Dark Faction will come knocking again."
"I am not your guard, okay? Why do you get to go out there and have fun while I handle your security for you?"
"Because you are the best mother one could ask for," Vexthra giggled. The Enchantress just smirked.
"Looks like that mortal boy really changed you. I wonder where the demon soul of yours ran off to."
"What can I say? Finding the right man is the best decision a goddess can ever make," Vexthra giggled again.
"You should try it sometime, Mom." She took a few steps back as if trying to get away from a certain strike range.

"Maybe I should tell Kent to use his last wish to wish for a night with you..." Her giggle was the only thing left in the room as she teleported away, narrowly evading a strike from the enchantress’s long hair.
"This shameless girl." A smile appeared on her face as she watched her go.
"She is right, you know. Maybe you should use the millions of wishes you have to wish for that..." A voice entered the temple, making the enchantress smirk.
"Are you tired of watching him live his life... pervert," the enchantress asked.

"As if you are doing any different. As the only two beings that can watch him and subtly spice up his life, I say we both are perverts," the voice said, momentarily making the enchantress’s cheeks turn colorful.
"Stop bothering me, I have things to do." She closed her eyes, causing the voice to giggle.
"I can’t wait to meet him again," the voice said before fading away. As for the enchantress, she smiled, leaning back in her chair.
"This brat, he never ceases to amaze. He can now evade the laws and sneak a god through the cracks. I wonder what he will do next."
Meanwhile, Kent appeared inside the tower and quickly made his way to Tower City to meet Mayor Gaia for a much-needed discussion.

chapters.title: Chapter 475: We Are Expanding
paragraphs: "What in Tupak’s name has happened to this place while I was gone?" Kent exclaimed, watching the large expanse of the majestic city standing before him.
It had more buildings, gardens, and everything else, all enhanced to look even better. Just looking at it made Kent want to smile.
However, a sudden voice spoke from behind him, making him frown and turn around.
"Beautiful, right?" Gaia said with a cute smile.
"What happened to this place?" Kent asked, as if he didn’t know what had happened.
"We are expanding, Master," Gaia said, dancing with her small arms.
"You still didn’t answer my question," Kent said.
"Let’s just say that after creating the ring for Goddess Vexthra, we had extra cash, so I used it to expand the city," Gaia answered with a guilty smile.
"How much exactly is this extra cash we are talking about?" Kent asked, but Gaia just smiled, making a sound that showed she was guilty as hell.
"You little devil, if I don’t hang you upside down—" Kent began chasing after the little brat, who had used creating the ring for Vexthra as an excuse to take Kent’s millions of tower points.
"No need to be angry, Master. This is for the future. You will soon have people in your city, and the more developed the place is, the happier and more comfortable they will be.
Or are you telling me you don’t want them to be happy?" Gaia giggled as she flew in the air like a bird, staying a step ahead of Kent.
Knowing that catching the sneaky Gaia wouldn’t be easy, Kent chose to give up and instead sat at the edge of a tall building overlooking the elegant city.
The process used in creating it was just too shameful, but he couldn’t deny that Gaia had indeed made the city much more beautiful.
Like she said, everyone will be happy to stay in the city for as long as they want.
"I will take 30 things from the tower shop as compensation," Kent said.
Gaia could only smile at his demands. She had extorted over 100 million tower points from the poor dragon, who had now become poor in tower points.
Not that he won’t recover soon. After running the 12 dungeons, he will recover his Tower points.
"So what changed while I was away?" Kent asked.

"Your new servant and her parents decided to stay here for the duration of their daughter’s service to you. But they asked me to tell you not to abuse their daughter. They really cherish her," Gaia said, sitting beside Kent.

"But aside from that, they have started their new life here and even begun cultivating herbs. They seem passionate about cultivating herbs. I think they will ask to stay here forever after the ten years."
"Good for them," Kent smiled.

"Also, from the donation you made to the city’s expansion, I managed to get them cultivation techniques to help them improve their cultivation bases, since as they cultivate, you get a share of their spiritual qi."
Kent could only shake his head, hearing her refer to extorting from him as a donation.
"Is that all?"
"Yes. However, I have also created the training space for Big Sister Nara and Zaila."
"Good one. I have a few more things that you will work on, but they can wait for now. I need to see the family of three."
"They are in the eastern part of the city," Gaia said, giving him the direction, and Kent flew away, heading in their direction.
When he was about 200 meters away, he flew down and decided to walk. From afar, he could see the family of three planting and watering herbs.
Gaia had provided them with all they needed, so as a family who dedicated their entire life to cultivating herbs, they didn’t shy away from working on their rather large garden all day.
Elaine was a little bit closer in Kent’s direction, so when he closed in on their location, she saw him first.
"Kent, what are you doing here?" she asked, a little nervous.
"Well, this is my city," Kent laughed, drawing the mother and father’s attention. They quickly walked closer and stopped beside their daughter.
They all looked nervous for some reason.
"Please, no need to look nervous. I just came to see if you need anything. The last time I was in a hurry, so I didn’t get to spend more time with you three."
"We are quite comfortable, Mr. Kent," Elaine’s father, Cedric, said.
"Please, just call me Kent. I am way too young to be called ’Mr..’" Kent laughed, bringing a much calmer air to the space.

The family of three still felt nervous, so Kent decided to lighten the mood. Of course, he needed something at that moment. Luckily for him, he knew something about planting, so he turned and looked at the farm.
"Can I join? I have a thing for gardens, and while this is not technically the kind of garden I worked on, I can help with the planting.
And please don’t say no." The family of three looked at each other for a moment before they nodded.
"Elaine, teach him how to go about it."
The innocent and obedient Elaine nodded.
"Take your shoes off first," she said blankly, looking at the handsome brat before her. Kent obeyed and removed his nice shoes.
He didn’t hesitate to step into the dirt. However, the moment he did, his brow rose.
"The soil is infused with healing magic. All the herbs we cultivate are for healing, and so we must always nurture them with healing magic, starting with the soil."
"I see. This feels nourishing. I could get addicted to it," Kent smiled, feeling the energy wash through his body.

"Take this and create a small hole in the ground. After that, infuse the seed with your spiritual qi and cover it with the dirt. Then water it... I will handle the rest." Elaine gave Kent a seed and a small hoe.
Kent looked at the hoe, and a smile appeared on his face.

"This brings back old memories," he muttered, remembering his life back on Earth. Though his life there hadn’t been the best, the time spent with his mom gardening when he was young was one of the rare memories he wouldn’t trade for anything.
He then did as he was told, perfectly planting the seed.

Elaine walked closer, placed her hand on the spot where he had planted the seed, and started muttering some strange words. A few minutes later, a sprout appeared, showing that the seed had been planted successfully.
"Congratulations, your first planting was a success," Elaine said with a rare smile that caused Kent to raise his brows again.
"I will name her Gigi," Kent said with a smile.
"You don’t name herbs. They already have their names."
"Well, this one will be called Gigi. No need to cry about it."
"You..." Elaine decided not to entertain him anymore. Elaine’s parents smiled as they watched the two kids from the side.
Kent just smiled and started working on planting more. He had six days inside the tower before the connection with Vexthra would be formed.
To her, she had six hours.
So for hours, Kent worked on the herb garden until night came. He planned on leaving, but Elaine’s mother stopped him.
"You must eat dinner with us first before leaving."
Naturally, Kent wouldn’t reject such a warm invite.

chapters.title: Chapter 476: The Fall of Life Magic
paragraphs: "So, Kent, where are you from?" Kent was seated around a table, eating rice balls with a rather delicious soup. Just a single bite was enough to send him back to Earth.
It wasn’t like he needed food as a cultivator, considering spiritual qi alone could make him go years without eating.
However, he chose to indulge in the fine delicacy prepared by the family of three, who were trying to thank him for saving them and their daughter.
Of course, he knew small conversations would be made, so when Elaine’s mother, Rain, asked the question, Kent just smiled and decided to enjoy the small talk.
"I am not from around here. I can even say I am from a very far place, but since I always make wherever I am home, then I can say this is my home now."
Telling them he was from Earth wouldn’t be something they could easily handle at the moment. Of course, he wasn’t afraid they would do anything to him.
It’s just that he didn’t want to give them a headache, so he would rather plan the story how he wanted it to be.
Maybe one day, they will find out his true origin.
"I see," Lady Rain said, smiling at Kent, who wasn’t shying away from eating his food.
"This is very delicious, Lady Rain. I will come for more whenever I am around," Kent said, taking a bite out of his fish.
"Thank you, Kent," the cheerful mother, who had already accepted that Kent was rather friendly and that they shouldn’t be nervous around him, said with a smile.
Mothers are always the best.
They knew when to ease into the moment. Thankfully, she knew how to keep Kent engaged while they dined.
"I can’t help but wonder, Lady Rain, why is Life Magic rare in this area? Where I am from, Life Magic is rather common," Kent said.
Of course, the Life Magic he was talking about referred to the thousands of brilliant doctors who used heaven-defying techniques to perform surgeries every single day.
If you want to lie, tell the truth like you mean it. He nearly told the true from his own perspective.
His question, however, showed genuine concern.
He didn’t know that his question brought back sad memories that the three would rather not discuss.
They hesitated, but Elaine’s father, Cedric, knew telling Kent wouldn’t be too much of an ask.
After all, he saved them and their daughter.
Cedric placed his cup down gently, exchanging a brief glance with his wife before speaking. It wasn’t a pleasant memory to relive.
"I’m sure you already know about the Ancient Battlefield of Parting, so I’ll spare you the backstory.
However, you might not know what truly happened — the event that forever changed the fate of Life Magicians in this world."
The family of three let out a heavy sigh, and even Lady Rain held Elaine’s hand tightly.
"Before the Parting, the Wynthrall family — the family I come from — was known as the beacon of Life Magic in this world.
The Wynthrall was a family of Life magicians. We were widely known and revered all over the world.
Back then, Core Formation wasn’t the limit of cultivation.
There were thousands of powerful beings roaming the vast, boundless world. The Wynthrall family stood among them, respected even by the elves, who were famed for their mastery of Life Magic.
It’s no exaggeration to say we were the light of life itself. Our Wynthrall family had tens of thousands of disciples scattered across the world, offering their healing arts and miracles to all.
Then came the Parting — a great battle that tore apart the world and shrank it into what it is today. Our Wynthrall family suffered the most because of the role we played.
We were the backbone on which every warrior depended. Thousands would have died had it not been for the Wynthrall family’s assistance when needed.
For the better part of the battles, we provided the services that were required of us.
However, when the battle reached its peak and humans were on the verge of victory, a disaster descended that would forever cripple humanity’s future.
A Tier 15 spell that nobody knew where it came from or who it came from was cast.
It was a powerful forbidden technique that cursed every Life Magician’s bloodline.
I don’t know all the details of the spell, considering this happened thousands of years before I was born.
But from what was passed down, it was clear that from the generations that came before us, the curse shackled their potential, and we inherited it.
It forever locked out bloodline, shackled our innate talents and abilities, and closed the Chapter of life magic in the human continent.
It limited all Life Magicians to Tier 5, meaning no one could ever advance beyond the fifth Tier in Life Magic again.
The curse didn’t only affect us humans, but even the Elves were affected.

Of course, there are rumors that the elves managed to find a way to reverse the curse. However, this remorse cannot be validated considering, up to date, nobody could tell who cast the spell and why they did that.
So even if the Elves did manage to reverse the curse, they wouldn’t tell anyone.
But we humans, my family especially, could not and would never be able to harness the power of life magic ever again.
Thus, we were reduced to a shadow of our former glory, forever bound to Tier 5.
Now, the strongest Life Magicians in the human continent are... well, us. And after hiding our identity for thousands of years, no one remembers who we once were.
We’ve quietly lived on, a small family still passionate about Life Magic, clinging to the last embers of a forgotten era.
It’s sad, but this happened thousands of years ago, and thus we can only accept the hand we were dealt."
Cedric laughed, but his laughter wasn’t that encouraging.
Kent, who knew this memory wasn’t pleasant, sighed deeply and washed his hands. He wasn’t satisfied, but he had to stop eating for now.
"Looks like I must pay a visit to the Elven empire soon," he said as he stood up.
"Though this happened thousands of years ago, I can promise you that life magic will appear in this world again, and this time, your potential will even overshadow that of your ancestors."
Kent picked a sliced orange and looked at Elaine. "Can you walk me out? I have something to discuss with you."
Elaine nodded and stood up. Kent looked at Lady Rain and Cedric and smiled. "The food was the best I’ve had in years. If possible, invite me whenever you prepare it again."
The lady, who was in shock from what Kent said, nodded. Cedric was the same. He also held a shocked expression as he watched Kent walk out of the dining room.
On the outside, Kent took Elaine’s hand and flew them to a floating platform several meters off the ground.
It was nighttime, so the stars and the thirteen moons were up in the sky, illuminating the glamorous city below.
Kent and Elaine sat on the platform and admired the night sky for a few minutes before speaking.
"Do you want to start making pills again?"

chapters.title: Chapter 477: Fractured Regions
paragraphs: Kent spent close to 10 hours with the Wynthrall family, so he knew why he asked Elaine this question.
During his time with them, he realized just how passionate the family of three was about cultivating herbs and life magic.
Kent saw it in their eyes; they would never stop the path they had started walking on. They looked determined and would forever walk that path.
So he knew this question had to be asked.
Elaine didn’t immediately answer. Instead, she stayed quiet for five minutes, staring at the beautiful starry sky.
"I don’t think I will ever touch a cauldron again," she answered, causing Kent to shake his head.
"I figured you would say something like that. But why, if you don’t mind me asking," Kent said, turning his head to look at Elaine.
"To be sincere, I only started alchemy to see if I could find a way to solve our life magic problem.
I saw how my parents were struggling to handle issues that required more than Tier 5 life magic, so I decided to seek other ways to see if they would work.
Of course, I quickly found my answer, but I was trapped and unable to free myself, so I had no choice but to play my role for all these years.
So while I love alchemy, cultivating herbs is something I want and would forever cherish, regardless of the state we are in."
"I see. That is alright." Kent wouldn’t force her to reconsider her decision.
He knew he would have made the same decision if he were in her shoes. The only question now was whether she would be okay getting stuck at the 5th Tier like her parents.
She is currently at the 4th Tier, but even without that, she wouldn’t be able to get past that stage and would forever be stuck there.
Her normal cultivation base was at the peak of the Great Sage realm, but she could never advance in life magic cultivation.
"I will find a way to solve your bloodline issue. For now, stay with your parents. I will have Gaia send over more seeds for different healing herbs.
Who knows, maybe one of these days you will be able to get past the 5th Tier."
Elaine nodded with a thankful and hopeful expression.
"Thank you for allowing me and my parents to stay here," she said.
"Don’t worry about it. I need more people to make the city lively, so see it as you three are my first residents," Kent said with a small smile.
"Of course, I would like to say, although you are my servant, it’s just in name. You don’t have to worry about serving me like the servants on the outside do," Kent made sure she understood.
Elaine nodded and stayed with Kent for another hour before leaving. Meanwhile, Kent remained on the platform for a couple of hours.
When dawn came, he summoned the three lolis: Gaia, Akira, and Dori.
"Go ahead, tell me what we are dealing with," Kent said, now seated on the stone platform.
Gaia was the first to speak.
⟪I can indeed sense their bloodline had been suppressed by a powerful spell that can only be found in the high worlds. It’s as they said, a Tier 15 spell...
It prevented them from awakening their bloodlines, and because of that, over the years, the potency, or more like the trace, of their bloodline keeps fading away.

Right now, aside from Elaine, who seems to have a much higher potency of their bloodline, her parents don’t. Her father has a trace, but it’s faint, and her mother has none simply because she is not from the same bloodline.
Of course, she learned to use life magic, but she wouldn’t awaken the bloodline even if the spell were to be broken.⟫
"I see. This is indeed troublesome," Kent scratched the back of his head.
"I don’t get it. If the spell was cast thousands of years ago, then why is it still in effect? I know for sure that the world’s parting limited the level of cultivation one could rise to Tier 12.
So since that was the case, why hadn’t the spell also been suppressed to the peak of this world?" Kent asked.
Since a Tier 15 spell was cast, now that the highest one could rise to in this world is Tier 12, why was the Tier 15 spell still in effect?
⟪Master, do you remember when I told you there are places that even I cannot see or access?⟫ Gaia asked, causing Kent to nod.
⟪Then this will be simple. I have scanned the entirety of this world, and strangely, there are two such places.

The first place is on the ancient battlefield of Parting. It’s a region called the Dead Zone where nobody dares enter. Since I can’t spy inside, I can’t tell what is hidden within this zone or why it can’t be entered.
You would have to find out yourself.
The second place is the Dark Region, or as most call it, the Dark Forest. It’s somewhere on the demon continent. It’s the second place.
These places are called the Fractured Regions. The laws are unstable there, so if I am not mistaken, this spell is still active in one of these two regions.
However, I have to warn the master. The Fractured Region, although still limited by the laws, can be abnormal.⟫
"How abnormal are we talking?" Kent asked.
⟪You might meet beings or monsters that, although they’re at the peak of this world, their true strength can rival those in the high worlds.
They are like Unique Worlds where the laws don’t apply, just that in these regions, the laws apply, but the limitations aren’t that effective.⟫
Akira took over.
⟪Also, the master can already see that despite making Elaine your servant, you still wouldn’t be able to bestow a true name on her when her trust level reaches the 80% level.
So you must look for a way to break this spell first. To do that, you must grow stronger in all aspects, for the biggest challenge you might face in this world can be found in the Fractured Regions.⟫
Kent stood up and took a big sigh.
"Looks like things never slow down regardless of how powerful you become," he smiled.
⟪It’s good that the master understands that. Thankfully, you have no shortage of manpower, so that can make some difference in the long run,⟫ Dori said with a smile.
Unlike her sisters, she knew Kent knew something about his subordinates since she had access to his mind. She saw Vexthra’s memory and knew what Kent knew...even better than him.
So she was just reminding him of his undead and Night Riders and the reason he has them.
"Have you ladies come up with the design for the next undead?" Kent asked, but Akira shook her head.
⟪We need a couple of days to do that. Thanks to our current supply, we don’t want to create anything weaker than Zareth.⟫
"Very well. I will go talk to Zareth now. I expect the design to be complete in two days’ time."
⟪It will be ready, Master.⟫
Kent nodded before vanishing into the Legion Tower, where his undead and Veydris were training.

sentences.text: Kent spent close to 10 hours with the Wynthrall family, so he knew why he asked Elaine this question.
During his time with them, he realized just how passionate the family of three was about cultivating herbs and life magic.
Kent saw it in their eyes; they would never stop the path they had started walking on.
They looked determined and would forever walk that path.
So he knew this question had to be asked.
Elaine didn’t immediately answer.
Instead, she stayed quiet for five minutes, staring at the beautiful starry sky.
"I don’t think I will ever touch a cauldron again," she answered, causing Kent to shake his head.
"I figured you would say something like that.
But why, if you don’t mind me asking," Kent said, turning his head to look at Elaine.
"To be sincere, I only started alchemy to see if I could find a way to solve our life magic problem.
I saw how my parents were struggling to handle issues that required more than Tier 5 life magic, so I decided to seek other ways to see if they would work.
Of course, I quickly found my answer, but I was trapped and unable to free myself, so I had no choice but to play my role for all these years.
So while I love alchemy, cultivating herbs is something I want and would forever cherish, regardless of the state we are in."
"I see.
That is alright." Kent wouldn’t force her to reconsider her decision.
He knew he would have made the same decision if he were in her shoes.
The only question now was whether she would be okay getting stuck at the 5th Tier like her parents.
She is currently at the 4th Tier, but even without that, she wouldn’t be able to get past that stage and would forever be stuck there.
Her normal cultivation base was at the peak of the Great Sage realm, but she could never advance in life magic cultivation.
"I will find a way to solve your bloodline issue.
For now, stay with your parents.
I will have Gaia send over more seeds for different healing herbs.
Who knows, maybe one of these days you will be able to get past the 5th Tier."
Elaine nodded with a thankful and hopeful expression.
"Thank you for allowing me and my parents to stay here," she said.
"Don’t worry about it.
I need more people to make the city lively, so see it as you three are my first residents," Kent said with a small smile.
"Of course, I would like to say, although you are my servant, it’s just in name.
You don’t have to worry about serving me like the servants on the outside do," Kent made sure she understood.
Elaine nodded and stayed with Kent for another hour before leaving.
Meanwhile, Kent remained on the platform for a couple of hours.
When dawn came, he summoned the three lolis: Gaia, Akira, and Dori.
"Go ahead, tell me what we are dealing with," Kent said, now seated on the stone platform.
Gaia was the first to speak.
⟪I can indeed sense their bloodline had been suppressed by a powerful spell that can only be found in the high worlds.
It’s as they said, a Tier 15 spell...
It prevented them from awakening their bloodlines, and because of that, over the years, the potency, or more like the trace, of their bloodline keeps fading away.
Right now, aside from Elaine, who seems to have a much higher potency of their bloodline, her parents don’t.
Her father has a trace, but it’s faint, and her mother has none simply because she is not from the same bloodline.
Of course, she learned to use life magic, but she wouldn’t awaken the bloodline even if the spell were to be broken.⟫
"I see.
This is indeed troublesome," Kent scratched the back of his head.
"I don’t get it.
If the spell was cast thousands of years ago, then why is it still in effect?
I know for sure that the world’s parting limited the level of cultivation one could rise to Tier 12.
So since that was the case, why hadn’t the spell also been suppressed to the peak of this world?" Kent asked.
Since a Tier 15 spell was cast, now that the highest one could rise to in this world is Tier 12, why was the Tier 15 spell still in effect?
⟪Master, do you remember when I told you there are places that even I cannot see or access?⟫ Gaia asked, causing Kent to nod.
⟪Then this will be simple.
I have scanned the entirety of this world, and strangely, there are two such places.
The first place is on the ancient battlefield of Parting.
It’s a region called the Dead Zone where nobody dares enter.
Since I can’t spy inside, I can’t tell what is hidden within this zone or why it can’t be entered.
You would have to find out yourself.
The second place is the Dark Region, or as most call it, the Dark Forest.
It’s somewhere on the demon continent.
It’s the second place.
These places are called the Fractured Regions.
The laws are unstable there, so if I am not mistaken, this spell is still active in one of these two regions.
However, I have to warn the master.
The Fractured Region, although still limited by the laws, can be abnormal.⟫
"How abnormal are we talking?" Kent asked.
⟪You might meet beings or monsters that, although they’re at the peak of this world, their true strength can rival those in the high worlds.
They are like Unique Worlds where the laws don’t apply, just that in these regions, the laws apply, but the limitations aren’t that effective.⟫
Akira took over.
⟪Also, the master can already see that despite making Elaine your servant, you still wouldn’t be able to bestow a true name on her when her trust level reaches the 80% level.
So you must look for a way to break this spell first.
To do that, you must grow stronger in all aspects, for the biggest challenge you might face in this world can be found in the Fractured Regions.⟫
Kent stood up and took a big sigh.
"Looks like things never slow down regardless of how powerful you become," he smiled.
⟪It’s good that the master understands that.
Thankfully, you have no shortage of manpower, so that can make some difference in the long run,⟫ Dori said with a smile.
Unlike her sisters, she knew Kent knew something about his subordinates since she had access to his mind.
She saw Vexthra’s memory and knew what Kent knew...even better than him.
So she was just reminding him of his undead and Night Riders and the reason he has them.
"Have you ladies come up with the design for the next undead?" Kent asked, but Akira shook her head.
⟪We need a couple of days to do that.
Thanks to our current supply, we don’t want to create anything weaker than Zareth.⟫
"Very well.
I will go talk to Zareth now.
I expect the design to be complete in two days’ time."
⟪It will be ready, Master.⟫
Kent nodded before vanishing into the Legion Tower, where his undead and Veydris were training.

chapters.title: Chapter 478: Zareth Val’Drex, The Undying Undead
paragraphs: When Vexthra said Kaizo was the leader of the undead that came from the future to save the day during the primordial Era, Kent nearly choked.
He most definitely did not see Kaizo being the leader. The name Undying Titan sounded like a joke, considering the Brute loves nothing more than fighting and punching things.
Kaizo being a leader doesn’t sound right.
However, witnessing him rising from the ground and charging back into the battle whenever Zareth strikes him down, Kent couldn’t help but see something different in him.
Kaizo has an unyielding spirit.
Regardless of how dire a battle gets, he will stand tall and keep charging forward.
That is the true spirit of a leader.
Kent could only stand on the side and watch his undead and Veydris duel it out like they were each other’s enemy. After an hour, they took a break.
Naturally, Kaizo was against the idea of a break, but Zareth knew Kent was there for him, so he let him rest with a promise they would fight for an entire day after he was done with Kent.
"Great to see you are not bullying them," Kent said, staring at his fourth Undead.
Zareth smiled, "I am not a bully."
He is a peak Root Sovereign, so letting him spar with the rest isn’t something they can handle. Even Veydris, who is abnormally strong, cannot compare to Zareth.
He is that powerful.
"Let’s talk over there," Kent said as he started walking in a certain direction. They settled down on white stone.
"What can you tell me about yourself?" Kent wanted to know why he is a True Undead. He wants to know what difference that makes and why he is who he is.
"Well, I don’t know anything aside from my nature as an Eldritch Warlock, master of the Coil Void Dragon and the Alasbaster Poison serpent, and the Curse Wizard.
Aside from that, everything else has been condensed in this memory crystal. Zarath retrieved a diamond-shaped crystal and gave it to Kent.

⟪That is indeed a memory, Crystal. It’s used to copy memories or store information you would want to keep for a very long time.⟫ Gaia described the crystal even before Kent could use the tower to appraise it.
⟪All you have to do is infuse your energy into it, and the information hidden inside will be transmitted to your mind directly⟫
"This is everything about me. I don’t know where I came from, but I know it has everything you want and need about me," Zareth said.
⟪It does contain everything, but only a few will be given to you. This Crystal contains a part of who he is and a connection that will later allow you to know more as he grows stronger.

You will know whenever something new happens to him, considering there is information about him and everything about his nature hidden inside this memory, Crystal.⟫ Dori, the mind weaver, corrected Zareth’s words.
Kent nodded and then, without any hesitation, he infused his energy into it. As expected, his mind was filled with what he needed to know and do.
It was mesmerizing yet strange. However, Kent now knew all about Zareth and what had to be done.
"You have a true name but haven’t been invoked yet." Kent said, "Why don’t we handle that first?"
Zareth nodded and stood up. Kent, who was ecstatic about the outcome of this invocation, smiled and got into character.

Legend spoke of an ancient beast known as the world Serpent, a creature said to be as old as time itself. Legend says that this creature came into the known when the Ones were the only beings walking the void.
They are called the Walkers of the Void. It followed them out and chose to live in the world of living beings.
It was a beast blessed with both the bloodline of the Ancient Coil Void Dragon and the Alasbaster Poison Serpent, two of the most dreadful bloodlines in the beast race’s history.
Legend has it that when the Walkers died, the World Serpent had nowhere to go anymore, so it chose to sleep in a place that is still known as the Valley of the World Serpent to this very day...
It was said that after hundreds of thousands of years, it remained asleep only to be woken up by the hunters. This was the era when beasts nearly went extinct.
Val’Drex was a demi-dragon.

He was half human and half dragon, so in the Dragon Empire, he sat at the bottom of the food chain. He held no value whatsoever in the grand scheme of things, so when the hunters came, he was left to fend for himself.

It wasn’t easy for someone who couldn’t even use dragon breath, so naturally, he was bound to die. And he did. However, in his last moment, he was saved by the world’s Dragon, who wanted one thing from him.
It saw his determination and chose to give him a second chance...
"The bond is simple, and it must be obeyed.
I will give you the power to overcome all your foes.
I will take you to the world’s end to inherit the ancient magic.
I will give you my two innate bodies as a form of protection.
You can use all my abilities if you are worthy.
All I ask is that when the Primordial Chaos Dragon shattered his soul on the eternal night of chaos, you must heed the called and respond to his summons.
Do you accept?" The World serpent asked.
"Yes, Ancestor..."
"Then you shall from now onwards be known as Oss’kyr Vraegorith, The Ender Who Wakes the Blood of the Coiled Gods".

Rise, Oss’kyr Vraegorith, your legend has just begun," Kent called out Zareth’s true name. When he spoke the True Name, Zareth’s body was swallowed in an eternal darkness, and he was pulled out of sight.
Then the entire Legend Tower grew cold.
Not the kind of cold that brushed against skin, but the kind that gnawed at the bones, at the soul itself.
The mist parted with a low hiss, and a figure stepped forward from within the swirling violet fog.
He looked imposing and well, and the two large horns on his forehead added to his imposing presence.
His warlock robe fluttered without wind, appearing to be an extension of something alive. He held no weapon.
His hair is silver-white and spiked. His eyes are serpentine—vertical pupils glowing amethyst.
A belt-like artifact sits on his waist—black metallic spheres embedded with serpent eyes, connected by arcane tendrils.
Suddenly, the space cracked behind him, and two large creatures appeared. One is a Large Dragon with eyes that reflect the void itself. The other is a serpent, also black but with pure white eyes.
They coil behind him, adding to Zareth’s imposing presence.
"True Names are the best," Zareth said with a small smile, looking straight at Kent, who was also smiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 479: Coiled Ancestor Bloodline
paragraphs: "So the two beasts behind you are the innate spirits of the Coil Void Dragon and the Alabaster Poison Serpent?" Kent asked, and Zareth nodded.
Kent had invoked Zareth’s true name, and as such, the contracting process that allowed Zareth to inherit the bloodline of the World Serpent was now complete.

This meant he now had the bloodline of two powerful beasts in him. He has already unlocked 20% of the Coiled Ancestor Bloodline, but this was already enough for him to harness it in ways nobody could imagine.
First, this would allow him to summon the spirits of the Coil Void Dragon and the Alabaster Poison Serpent, which were the innate spirits of the original beasts.
This means they are not created from Zareth’s energy...
Strangely, their strength was that of someone at the peak of the Core Formation stage. However, Kent knew they went deeper than that, just by feeling their aura.

Also, Zareth could use Eldritch magic and create curses thanks to the blessing of the World Serpent. As for weapons, the scythe was already enough for him, considering he could also create weapons out of thin air.
Not to mention, the bloodline of the World Serpent granted him an incredibly rare ability: the Power of Word Weaving.
With it, Zareth could bind reality itself through spoken incantations, creating chains, barriers, and even devastating attacks by simply uttering specific phrases tied to ancient laws.
Kent watched silently, noting how the two spirits floated behind Zareth with majestic and oppressive auras.
The Coil Void Dragon’s form shimmered like a shifting void, bending light and space, while the Alabaster Poison Serpent coiled lazily, exuding a venomous mist that corroded even the air.
"You are insanely powerful, Zareth," Kent laughed, knowing his future battles would be one less chaotic thanks to his presence.
He couldn’t help but wonder what would become of Kaizo, Vaelros, and Sylara when they reached the Root Sovereign stage and awakened their own True Names.
Zareth had awakened the Coiled Ancestor Bloodline and now had a True Name. This, in a way, meant he was destined to keep rising without any limitations.
"Tell me, how would you continue to grow? Kaizo needs metallic minerals, and you saw Vaelros and Sylara; they need blood, so what about you?" Kent asked.
"I just need a large number of beast bodies. It doesn’t matter how weak they are; I need their bodies to extract the energy from them.
In fact, if I can get more now, it would be great. I have the blessing of the World Serpent, but I need to do a ritual if I want to awaken even one of his powerful skills.
So if I can get more beast bodies now, I will be very happy," Zareth said.
"How many are we talking here?" Kent asked.
"A lot," Zareth answered.
Kent, of course, thought about it for a few minutes and sighed.
"I guess keeping you five in here is a little suffocating." He brushed his chin and then retrieved three cards.
"These three cards will allow you to access dungeons. I don’t know how many levels are in each dungeon, but I know the last-floor bosses will be at the peak of the Root Sovereign stage.
So, since you need bodies, I guess you should take the four of them with you and clear these twelve dungeons." Kent handed him the first card.
"That one will allow you to access ten SS-rank dungeons, while these two access one each. With all five of you working together, this will be over soon." Kent handed the other two cards over.
He went ahead and retrieved twelve Dungeon Master Tokens.
"Whenever you clear a dungeon, use one of these to claim it. All you have to do is attach it to the dungeon’s core, which is located on the last floor. The rest will be done by me."
Zareth accepted the cards with a smile.
"By the time you are done with the 12 dungeons, I will also be done here, then we can go ahead with the real mission, where the odds will be much steeper.
Zareth nodded, and they went away with the items stored in his unknown storage. Kent stood and watched as he delivered the mission to his teammates, causing Kaizo to punch the air excitedly.
The brute who craves battle was the most excited. Kent knew the next time they met, he would be a little satisfied.
Kent smiled and left.
He appeared in the harem tower next, where he immediately located his ladies inside the Yin Pool, cultivating.

However, he also senses Protector Vari inside the garden, also cultivating. After a few back and forth, he chose to see her first, considering she most definitely has thousands of questions to ask him.
He was soon inside the garden, walking toward the direction of the Kingdom Protector, who came to his aid when he needed it.
Of course, with Zareth around, the chances of Kent getting hurt or even being overwhelmed are nonexistent.
Even before invoking his true name, Zareth could harness some part of the Coiled Ancestor Bloodline, so he was formidable and could have held back two Kingdom Protectors without much difficulty.
But the fact that she went out of her way to even face the strongest of the three who came after Kent shows she held their brother sister relationship in her heart.
She clearly appreciated all the help Kent gave her. So she wanted to pay him back in her own way, and that was holding back one of her fellow Kingdom Protectors.
After walking for a couple of seconds, Kent appeared in the location she was cultivating, but he stepped as their gaze met.
He stared into her eyes and smiled at her before walking nearer to her.
"How are you doing, Big sister?" Kent asked, stopping in front of her and sitting down.
"I am fine, thanks to you," She replied with a soft expression. She woke up about a week ago, considering that only three days passed on the outside, but 72 days passed inside the tower.
"Thanks for helping me deal with those three idiots," Kent said again, studying her expression.
"Tsw," She chuckled, "I have a feeling even without my help, you would have come out unscathed." A rare smile appeared on her face, then replaced by a helpless sigh.

"Looks like the name Kingdom Protector is just a joke. To think a mere Great Sage could sever the arm of a level 3 Core formation expert. Just who or what I you?" Lady Vari asked with a bittersweet smile.
Her confidence is shaken, and Kent could see it. This caused him to smile.
"No need to look down on yourself, big sister. I am just awesome, capable, Handsome, and extremely powerful, that’s all."
Lady Vari could only shake her head.
"Tell me where I am."

The plan is to grow stronger by unlocking pieces of his memories as time passes.
He wouldn’t want to be negatively affected while trying to grow stronger.
"I know that, Gaia.
It’s just surprising to know I was once an assassin and was even named Faceless Assassin.
I just can’t fathom it," Kent said with a slight smile.
He would be lying if he said he wasn’t intrigued to know more about the assassin’s life he once led.
⟪No need to be overly happy, Master.
You’ll be surprised by the kind of person you were in all your incarnations.⟫ Dori didn’t want to go too far into that, so she left it to Kent’s imagination.
Naturally, his interest was piqued.
He knew he had to get to know himself soon.
⟪Congratulations on completing the quest ’Dominate the Four Kingdoms’.
Your rewards have been released.⟫
⟪Rewards: Received⟫
→ 30 million Tower Points
→ Three True Name Tokens
→ Primordial Assassin Path (3rd)
→ Undead Schematic Creator x4
→ Memory Key (Jest)
→ Memory Key (Chaos Dragon)
→ Realm Crystal
Kent didn’t even know what to say, considering the overwhelming rewards.
Most were the same as the previous ones, but were far from simple.
Now, he had three more chances to learn more about Jest.
But on top of that, he also had two chances to uncover his life as the Chaos Dragon.
This was just insane by all standards.
Dori could even tell Kent had indeed gained a lot this time.
However, while she was happy for him, her attention was rather on the last reward...
⟪The Master should use the Realm Crystal,⟫ Dori said, and Kent took out a whitish crystal housing countless runes.
⟪This Realm Crystal allows you to experience a realm created based on a path you wish to explore.
You can will it to show you a realm created around the sword path, soul cultivation, or even body cultivation.
And yes, you can comprehend a Realm for body cultivation.
It all depends on how you want to experience it.
The goal is to gain some insight you can use to begin comprehending your own realm.⟫
"I see.
This is good stuff," Kent pondered for a moment, then turned to Dori.
"Between my sword, soul, and body, which one should I go for?" Kent asked.
⟪Master should go for the soul, considering you are strongest in that aspect.
Comprehending a Realm for soul cultivation starts at Tier 10, and you’re already there.
So, for better results, you should go for the soul.
If you want, you can ask that Sword King to take you through his sword realm the next time you meet him.
You can even ask the assassin lady inside the Tower—she also has a realm.
Though weak, the two can help shed some light on the weapon realm.⟫
"I guess soul cultivation is." Kent made up his mind on this aspect.
I can even feel that, by the time I exhaust the three remaining keys for Jest’s memories, I will experience his sword realm, which will help me understand more about weapon realms." Kent sighed.
He even wondered if he could inherit Jest’s sword realm.
But for now, the focus is on the Soul.
His soul cultivation was already halfway to the Tier 11 stage.
So he knew that after adding Nara and Lady Lani to the harem, he would reach the 11th Tier.
When that happens, he must at least be able to use his soul cultivation more effectively.
Though he couldn’t use it against those without a realm, Kent had already started playing in the big leagues, so he had to prepare accordingly.
He channeled his energy into the crystal, causing it to burst into sparkles of bright light.
This made him close his eyes.
He was hovering in the air when he opened them, looking over a vast river.
It was calm, quiet, and beautiful.
Suddenly, a wave surged.
Kent felt his soul get pressed down, and like a falling stone, he plunged into the river.
However, the moment he touched the water, a voice echoed in his mind:
"Welcome to the River of Hell."

chapters.title: Chapter 485: River of Hell (1)
paragraphs: The place Kent arrived in was the realm he wished for.
The realm crystal had taken his wish, which in this case was the Soul Realm. He wished for that type of realm.
The rest would be based on how the crystal worked. Kent wouldn’t know where he would appear or how the realm would look and behave.
That was completely random, so he was taken aback when he appeared, hovering in the air over a large expanse of river.
However, his soul also felt at peace in that very moment. Perhaps that was how it was meant to be or what he wanted to feel.
But that tranquility didn’t last for long when he felt a sudden pressure fall on his soul. It wasn’t a physical push; it felt more like a powerful force pressing against his soul.
Then he lost his balance and plunged into the depths of the river, sinking to the bottom instantly. The pull of or push on his soul was so powerful that he had no control over his own body.
Then the name of the Realm was spoken.
While having a good swim would have been great, the realm name alone made him instantly break into a cold sweat despite being submerged in water.
"Welcome to the River of Hell." The voice was the same as the tower’s. However, despite having become addicted to that feminine voice over the past months, he felt this tone was a little icy.
It sounded cold and emotionless. This made him sense that something was amiss, and to confirm that, a second sentence entered his mind, making Kent finally understand what he had found himself in.
"You are now inside a Tier 3 Soul Realm called the River of Hell. Since this is a Tier 3 Soul Realm, you will go through three phases, each more powerful than the last.
It will feel like you are facing the owner of this realm, meaning you must see this as a real deal.
While you can easily die when caught in this realm, you won’t die here, but you will experience death three times because you don’t have what it takes to withstand this realm.
Of course, you are immune to soul attacks, but while that would help you in the outside world, this is the soul world, where I have supreme control, and so I removed that immunity from your soul.
This is to ensure you are fully immersed in the experience. It will be over sooner than you think, so absorb as much as possible."
"Akira, I know it’s you. You’d better be prepared for what I have in store for you after you are done tricking me," Kent said.
He was able to talk even inside the river.
"I didn’t trick you, Master. I just let my pal, Tower, speak in that tone. This is to make you understand the dangers of realms."
"You may be immune to soul attacks, but not sword, bow, mage, axe, and other realms. So, have your first experience. Let it be your first learning curve.
I am sure you will thank me after"
The moment Akira’s voice faded, the river started to surge. Kent quickly sensed he was in for a wild ride, so he prepared to soak everything in, even to the bitter end.
He won’t die permanently, but he will die.
"River of Hell," the Tower spoke again, still maintaining that icy tone. However, as the river surged, Kent began to feel the water getting hotter and hotter.
"Calling the Creatures from the Trenches." The river immediately became still, as if it had never surged. It was now calm.
However, from two kilometers away, he saw a wave coming toward him—a wild wave capable of swallowing Moutians.
It was surging toward him like a tsunami.
Yet, as harrowing as the wave appeared, his soul sank further when his eyes landed on the thousands of grotesque-looking creatures, each housing thousands of teeth in their maw.
They came with the wave, and before Kent knew it, he was swarmed from all sides. Though Kent knew he wouldn’t die, he instinctively released a soul wave, trying to push them back.
However, his soul attack merely washed over the creatures, doing nothing to stop them.
"What? These are Tier 13 soul creatures!" Kent immediately recognized the rank of the creatures. Each was a Tier 13 soul creature, meaning they were at least at the Spirit Ascension stage.
Kent watched as the creatures swarmed him. But the scene paused just before a thirteen-meter-tall trench beast was about to bite into him.
Kent might have been underwater, but the scene around him terrified him, causing him to break into a cold sweat.
"Master, I know you’re wondering just how this is possible—I mean, you’re about to be bitten in half by a Tier 13 soul beast that can only be found in the Fourth Level of Hell."
Akira giggled, making Kent narrow his gaze in a random direction.
"This is possible because of a person’s knowledge of soul cultivation and the strength of their soul. You are a soul cultivator, Master, but you don’t possess a soul art."
"Goddess Vexthra gave you one, but you have yet to start using it. This means that while you are a Tier 10 soul cultivator, the highest level of soul attack you can unleash is Tier 10."
"I’d say it’s more like the basic form of a Tier 10 soul attack. True attacks come from knowing how the soul works and understanding your soul art."
"I don’t want to talk much, so feel the realm, and we will talk more about the soul art."
"Wait—" Kent wanted to adjust himself first before the scene unpaused, but the cheeky Akira didn’t wait for him.
It was instant, and before he knew it, he was bitten in half and died...
Or more like he tried dying, since the moment he died, he appeared in the calm river again.
"That was intense," Kent sighed, watching deep into the water that spread as far as the eye could see. he couldn’t help but wonder just what just happened.
The first tier wasn’t something someone could handle, not when they didn’t have a realm of equal strength.
If that was the case, then what about the next second and third?

"The master should be ready for the second one," Akira said. "While the first was terrifying, the second will be even more so, considering it was comprehended and formed after making a breakthrough in soul art."
"Bring it on," Kent said, making a come-get-me gesture.
"Be careful, Master. In this universe, there are some things that those with weak wills can’t handle," Akira warned.
"Are you calling me weak?" Kent asked.
"You are not weak, Master, but sometimes, you must know when to step back." The moment Akira said that, the tower activated the second tier of the River of Hell.
"Calling the Creatures of the Deep: Hellmongers."
The water turned dark in an instant, causing Kent to gasp. Thankfully, no water entered his mouth. That would have been embarrassing, considering he was deep inside a river.
Then, from deep within the depths of the river, crimson eyes exuding potent soul energies lit up, changing the hue of the water from dark to red.
The river surged...

chapters.title: Chapter 486: River of Hell (2)
paragraphs: "What in the hell is this shit?"
The water around Kent was literally boiling like it had been set on fire. Kent was a cultivator, so pouring even acid on him wouldn’t hurt him, much less fire.
However, the longer the water boiled, the hotter his soul got.
His skin wasn’t burning, but his soul was on fire, and as he continued to watch the crimson eyes draw closer, he couldn’t help but wonder just where these creatures were from.
They looked larger than mansions, and their forms were even more grotesque than the Trenchs. They appeared towering, monstrous, and even more so, devastating to the mind.
Kent could only watch them draw closer. The closer they got to him, the blurrier his vision became, considering the pressure coming from the creatures wasn’t something he could withstand.
However, when they were a kilometer away, Kent could only close his eyes as his soul ignited like dynamite, blasting into smithereens.
He died before he could comprehend the true nature of the arrived creatures. They are also creatures from the 4th level of hell.
However, they are much larger, stronger, and horrifying than the previous ones.
"Just what kind of soul art did this person comprehend to be able to form such a soul realm?" Kent wondered as he found himself back in the calm depths of the river.
He wanted to take a moment to calm his beating heart; however, before he could do that, the tower spoke, activating the River of Hell’s tier three form.
"Calling the Grim Scythe."
This time, the river remained calm, causing Kent to look around and wonder what was happening.
There were no sudden surges, no harrowing waves, nothing. Everything was calm, like when he first fell into the river. The tranquility in the air was palpable.
However, while he would have loved to experience the third form with a sense of peace, the next second proved harrowing, as darkness appeared in the air and began falling toward the river.
"Calling the Grim Scythe; Cleave Through the River of Hell."
The tower spoke again just as Kent lifted his head and saw the river split in half. He was cut in half alongside the river.
Gaia, Dori, and Akira were smiling when he opened his eyes, gasping for breath.
⟪How did it go, Master?.⟫ Akira asked with a giggle. Her two sisters also couldn’t keep their smiles away.
"It was dangerous and terrifying," Kent responded, knowing there was no point in acting tough.
He could tell he was out of his league from the first to the last tiers of the Soul Realm he had just experienced.
He would not have done any better than what had just happened. The realm he experienced now belongs to the King of he 4th level of hell.
They call him the 4th Calamity, for hell is ruled by 13 calamities, like how the six queens and seven kings rule the underworld.
But Kent doesn’t know that, and Akira had no plans on telling him.
⟪Master, would you believe me if I told you that a Tier 11 Soul Master created the realm you have just experienced?⟫ Akira asked, and Kent looked at her as if asking whether she was kidding.
⟪She’s being serious, Master. The realm you just experienced is from a Tier 11 soul cultivator. However, this person is someone who has already started comprehending a soul art.
This allowed him to understand soul cultivation to a level I’m afraid you can’t yet comprehend. I’m saying this because you will soon begin cultivating the one Goddess Vexthra gave you.⟫
Gaia said, making Kent wonder who this person is.
"I know. It’s just that I couldn’t understand how someone could comprehend such a powerful realm. I felt like a bug when facing the three tiers." Kent took a deep sigh.
He then lay his head on the sword bridge, gazing into the starry sky.
"I need to comprehend my own realm," Kent declared.

⟪Master can do that. However, you are to begin to tread a path in soul cultivation. Once again, Goddess Vexthra gave you one that even I don’t know where in this world she got her hands on something like that.⟫
⟪But you must first start comprehending it to understand,⟫ Akira smiled, saying that. She can’t wait to get started with Kent.
Gaia is his builder, Dori is his mind manager, and soon, she will be his soul guardian, as it was always meant to be.
⟪The realm you just experienced was created by a soul cultivator walking the Hell Path in soul cultivation. This allowed him to create such a powerful realm.
I know this may sound confusing, but the path you walk determines the realm you can comprehend and create.
Take Big Sister Elsa, for example—she is walking the Astra Soul Bridge.
That is her path, and while she hasn’t crossed the first bridge yet, she has already gained enough to begin comprehending a realm once she reaches the 10th Tier in soul cultivation.
You’re already walking a sword path, so the moment you become a Sword King, you can start comprehending a realm—but not with the soul. You need the path first.⟫
"I think I understand the gist of it. Basically, a realm is created from the path you’re walking."
⟪Yes. Once you’re done with your minor issues, you must awaken the path Goddess Vexthra gave you.
I don’t want to spoil it, but she must have gone to great lengths to get that path. I’m even sure that if the Celestials find out you’re in possession of such a soul path, they’ll hunt you down.
But don’t worry—I’m here now, so they won’t be able to find out, at least while you’re below the Immortal Worlds.⟫
"I understand," Kent sighed again, then thought back to the last tier of the realm he had just experienced.
Remembering how terrifying the scythe looked and how harrowing it felt when it cleaved through the river, he wondered if he could gain something from it.
"I need someone to fight with," Kent said, standing up.

⟪Zareth, Kaizo, Big Sister Sylara, Vaelros, Sir Veydris, and the 13 Metal Battle Dolls are currently away on the mission you gave them, so you don’t have anyone aside from your women and the Assassin woman,⟫ Dori answered, but Kent didn’t bother with that.
He looked toward the fifth level of the sword bridge, and a smile appeared on his face.
"I just want to try something out, so dying once shouldn’t be a problem," he muttered, then started walking toward the fifth level of the sword bridge.
He had already passed the first four levels, so he walked through them like they were nothing.
However, the moment he stepped onto the fifth level, the air around him turned sharper and more lethal.
Kent became alert immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 487: Kill With A Single Strike
paragraphs: The fifth level was like a domain of suffocating sword intent.
Kent felt the very air cutting him like a blade. His body was pressed down as if heaven were falling on him.
’This is powerful,’ he said to himself as he used his senses to figure out the level of sword intent and qi currently filling the air.
"Level 5 Profound Qi." He muttered
Kent immediately knew there was no way he could match that with his Level 9 Enhance Sword Qi. He was only a step away from entering the Profound Qi stage, but knew he stood no chance.
"I should have practiced more and unlocked another memory from Jest before coming." He sighed as he gazed at the clone version flying down from the air.
This one was purple and wielding two swords.
The previous four wielded only one sword, but this man wielded two, and the sword qi swirling around them was enough to tell him he was out of his league.
However, Kent wasn’t there with the hope of defeating the clone. His plan was rather simple; he came to test a skill he was envisioning.
His fascination with this skill started when he first witnessed Jest’s memories.
Jest once participated in a sword duel, witnessing a duel between a certain young man who seemed to know only one sword skill.
Swing.
That was the name of the skill this young man created, and from what Kent saw, this young man even became second in the competition after he failed to defeat Jest.
It was a single move: he swung his sword and created a single sword arc from his sword qi and intent.
It was that simple, yet Kent could tell it went deeper than one could envision, and thus, he became fascinated by it.
The second was inside the sword gaze enlightenment. The Lunar Eclipse Slash skill he had mastered was also similar in that regard.
A single crescent arc flashed out from the eye and cleaved through any obstacle. That was more than a person could ask for, and Kent wanted to be able to do the same.
The third was the second form of the Annihilation Sword technique, Void Cleave. This skill was similar to the first two, but Kent saw some potential that the current Void Cleave doesn’t have.
While the Void Cleave utilized the Void and distance, Kent wanted a skill that could be regulated by the user regardless of distance or condition.
So he wanted to see if he could do something similar.
Naturally, as someone who practiced the sword mind, he had been working inside his mind for the past weeks, hoping to make a breakthrough, but there was only failure at every turn.
However, that changed when he experienced the River of Hell Realm. The first two tiers were of no use; it was the third that caught his attention.
When the scythe cleaved through the River, something snapped in his mind that made him make a breakthrough in his quest to create a sword move.
He knew there were thousands of similar sword moves out there, but his own was something he planned to take a different route with. This meant he wouldn’t be using the same trend as everyone.
So when he made the breakthrough, his urge to try it rose, and right now, standing 10 meters away from a being whose single movement could be the end of him, Kent couldn’t help but smile.
His sword appeared in his hand, causing his energy to rise to its peak in an instant.
Then he raised the sword and trailed his index finger across it, making it shine under his touch.
"Just one strike will do," he muttered as his energy poured into the sword. Then he moved and executed a single powerful swing that caused a 3-meter-wide sword arc to flash out from his swing.
The white sword arc moved through the air, closing in on the clone in an instant. The strike was vertical, so the arc was also moving vertically.
In response to Kent’s attack, the clone crossed its swords in defense, hoping to block it.

However, just when the arc touched the swords, the two blades disintegrated like paper put into a fire. They disintegrated, and the sword arc cut through the clone before it could even move or split its body.
Thud.
Kent’s sword fell from his hands and landed on the ground right as his body also collapsed.
He passed out before he could even see what really happened.
The moment the arc left his sword, his mind gave out, and he lost consciousness. It was just that he fell a little too late, so it appeared he saw everything.
But the truth was, before the sword arc even left his sword, he had already lost consciousness. It was that serious.
Standing on the sword bridge inside the fourth level, Gaia, Dori, and Akira had their mouths wide open and their eyes housing their shocked expressions.
⟪That did not just happen. You all saw that right⟫ Akira said, watching her sisters.
⟪I saw what you also saw, Akira. We both saw the master use a sword move that contains a trace of the sword realm manifestation,⟫ Dori answered.
⟪That shouldn’t be possible, right? He hasn’t even reached the stage to start comprehending one. So why was he able to use it?⟫ Gaia asked, watching Kent’s unconscious body.
⟪There are many variables in this, but the likely one is that he gained the insight from the soul realm, and while he doesn’t know it, his understanding of what he saw went deeper.
His sword remembers and was able to bring out a trace of what he captured. It might even be that he doesn’t understand what happened.
Master cultivates the sword mind, and as such, we both know what that means.
It means his mind and sword are the same. So whatever he envisions, he can translate with his sword.
So, while his body, rank, and understanding may not have allowed him to harness the sword realm, his mind was able to speak to his sword.
However, this is bad. His body cannot harness the power of a realm, meaning whenever he uses it, his own body will pay the price.⟫
Dori had many theories, but so far, this was the only one she found plausible and likely to align with what Kent had just achieved.
⟪Then what should we do?⟫ Gaia asked.
⟪Nothing. We wait for the master to wake up.⟫

chapters.title: Chapter 488: Pill Grandmaster
paragraphs: Though the Sword Bridge heals all wounds right after the battle, regardless of who won, Kent didn’t immediately wake up after he killed the fifth-level clone that was close to becoming a Sword Sage.
He remained comatose for close to three days before he woke up with a splitting headache. Not even the sword bridge was able to save him from the physical and mental torture he went through.
"Damn, I lost and on top of that, I passed out and woke up wirg a head splitting headache" Kent muttered, trying to adjust his vision to the light.
He had just woken up, so the light was a little penetrating to the eye.
⟪The master might want to check the tower messages first before making any assumptions⟫, Gaia’s voice entered Kent’s mind.
Her words made Kent turn to the messages he had received, and to his shock, he saw a message that made him widen his eyes.
⟪Congratulations on passing the 5th level of the Sword Bridge⟫
"How did this happen?" Kent asked, looking visibly shocked.
⟪The master killed the clone, obviously⟫, Akira answered with a cheeky smile. They seem to find joy in teasing him.
Kent was in shock hearing that, but Akira wasn’t paying much attention.
"Then the sword skill worked," Kent laughed. "It actually worked." He was ecstatic to the point that he even forgot about the headache and started smiling and laughing his heart out.
⟪Congratulations, Master. However, I have some bad news⟫, Dori said, knowing this had to be said.

"Let me guess, because I gained clarity from a Realm, the sword contains traces of a Realm, which in this case is bad for me because I don’t have the body and the mental strength to handle it," Kent said, and the three ladies stood there watching him like they’d seen a genie.
"Don’t look at me like that. I was once Jest, and from what I knew of that life, he was fascinated by things like this. This means I am also fascinated by things like this now.

Plus, it wasn’t really much of a hassle. I had already anticipated this happening. That was why I wanted to test it on the Sword Bridge, where I would be healed regardless of how wounded I was in the end."
⟪Looks like you weren’t just being reckless. You’ve actually put a lot of thought into this. I am impressed, Master⟫, Dori smiled like a proud teacher.
As a Mind Weaver, she was fascinated by intelligent people. What Kent just said made her see her master in a new light.
As such, she became proud of him.
⟪But the master knows he can’t use this skill until he becomes a Sword King. The skill you created is powerful, but you can’t use it simply because your body and mind can’t handle it.
Sadly, the Tower didn’t consider it as a foundation for the sword skill you are required to create before becoming a Sword Saint.
This means you still have to create them from scratch⟫.
"I see. This is actually okay. I want to understand the basics more, and creating two foundations will make me gain more than I know now."
Kent took a deep breath and looked into the distance of the Sword Bridge.
"I will be able to achieve that after winning all 13 levels. Jest will also help me in this regard." The three beautiful lolis beside him nodded.

"Also, I need a path for mind cultivation at some point. I can’t tell if my mind will grow to the level of my soul, but if it does, I can use this skill without losing consciousness or reaching the sword king stage," Kent said, and Dori nodded.

⟪That is indeed true, Master. However, mind cultivation is very difficult and rare. Still, I will see what the Tower and I can do for you⟫, Dori answered, and Kent nodded. He was already pleased with his gains.
The sword skill he created was a success, just that he couldn’t use it. But aside from that, he now knew his understanding of the sword was advancing rapidly.
The only thing left was to gain enlightenment, and his sword skills would jump to a new level. He had already absorbed two memories from Jest and five clones from the Sword Bridge.
When it came to his understanding of the sword, he was at a stage even Sword Sages couldn’t brag about.
Kent sat back down and pulled up the messages again.
He could now split his body into six and even hide them well enough that a Sword Sage wouldn’t be able to track them until it was too late.
After snooping around for a few seconds, Kent landed on the next big thing.
"I am now a Pill Grandmaster." A rare smile appeared on his lips. He felt the knowledge from the Primordial Pill Records now in his mind.
He has access to thousands of pill recipes, flame techniques, and to some extent, secrets any pill grandmaster will be thrilled to have.
He has access to much more than his mind could even start to comprehend.
The requirements were fulfilled when he defeated Elaine, so he was now a Pill Grandmaster who could concoct Tier 3, 4, and 5 pills.
Kent already knew this beforehand, so he wasn’t too shocked. However, that didn’t mean he was feeling calm at the moment.
"I have a new flame, too." The first flame he received was the Blue Void Flame, which was perfect for extracting medicinal essence from herbs.
Now, however, he had received a new one called the [Golden Purity Flame]. From its name, one could tell what its use would be.
It could be used for purifying pills, and knowing that concoction only got more difficult as he advanced, this was perfect for him. He most definitely needed this flame.

Though his purity is already at the peak, that isn’t enough to make the pill purer. The pill can contain more essence in the scenes that its effect will be even higher than other pills of the same purity level.
He extended his hand and summoned the Golden Purity Flame. The moment it appeared, he felt a sense of peace, purity, and tranquility.
His soul felt at peace, and he couldn’t be any happier.
⟪Congratulations, Master. You have taken yet another step in the path of Pill Making⟫, Gaia congratulated him, causing Kent to turn and look at the three cheeky assistants.

"All I need now are Tier 3, 4, and 5 herbs, and I will start taking the next steps toward becoming a Pill Saint. This will even allow me to release some of my pills to the outside world," Kent smiled.
He was happy to have made progress. The next step will be to make his name known worldwide. This, of course, was his way of stepping into his Alchemy path.
However, the cheeky Gaia always knew how to ruin his day, so while he was happy with what he had accomplished, Gaia seemed to have plans in mind for him.
⟪The master would want to look at the requirements for the next stage. I doubt you will remain enthusiastic after seeing it⟫.
