chapters.title: Chapter 489: Difficult Requirements
paragraphs: The mention of the next requirements dampened Kent’s mood. It was hard on him at the Pill master stage, so he knew he was in for another shock.
He turned to the messages to find out what was required of him to become a Pill Saint.
At this point, it wasn’t about wanting but more about becoming, for his path went higher than the Pill Grandmaster stage.
[To qualify to become a Pill Saint, you must complete the following requirements:]
→ Concoct 10 Tier 5 Perfect Pills
→ Concoct a Tier 6 Perfect Pill
→ Concoct a Tier 7 Perfect Pill
→ Gain at least two enlightenments in the pill path
→ Defeat the Pill Princess in an Alchemy Duel

"Wait a minute, aren’t these requirements a little out of line? I mean, it’s fine asking me to concoct ten Tier 5 pills. But isn’t it too much to ask me to make Tier 6 and 7?" Kent muttered, reading through the requirements again.
⟪The master should know that these requirements are to prepare you for the next stage, and so, while they may look out of line, they are a way for you to challenge yourself⟫.
Gaia responded with a smile that contrasted with her words.
The requirements are indeed to prepare him for the next stage in the pill path. But isn’t the whole point of becoming a Pill Saint so he could concoct Tier 6 and 7 pills?
If he was required to do that in the Pill Grandmaster stage, then what would become of him at the Pill Saint stage?

⟪No need to overthink this, Master. This is where you separate yourself from the traditional Alchemist. Since you will be making Tier 6 and 7 pills at the Grandmaster stage, it means you will always be ahead of those in the same realm as you.
So while it can’t be proven now, the moment you become a Pill Saint, you will be required to concoct Tier 8 pills, which are for the Pill Sages.
Then, at the Sage stage, you will enter the Pill King stage. This isn’t to dampen your mood but to prepare you to rise further in your path to the peak.
The master had to know that you must be at the Pill King stage to be taken seriously in any sect or guild in the high worlds. So, embrace this new change and prepare accordingly.⟫
Dori explained, and Kent could only nod.
"Two enlightenments, huh? Looks like I have a lot to do. So I guess its a good thing I have all the time to do them inside the tower."
⟪That is fortunate for you. Thankfully, there is no time limit this time for you to race against. So you indeed have all the time in the tower world to learn and reach your goals⟫.
"Now, the only question here is who this Pill Princess is," Kent asked, looking at his three assistants for answers. However, they just stared at his face and continued to smile.
They knew who this person was, but they wouldn’t tell him, considering it would be worthwhile for him to find out himself.
However, Kent wasn’t stupid. He knew that for a name or title to be dropped in his requirements, the tower must really hold this person in high esteem.
This made him start to feel giddy for the day he would meet this mysterious person and perhaps look forward to their duel.
But it would have been fun knowing about this Pill Princess for now.
"I will find out one day, then," Kent stood up and vanished, appearing in the tower city. It had been a long time since he had spent some time with the little human he rescued back in Caprath City.
He plans to spend some time with her. Li Hua is like his baby sister, so he misses her a bit.
When he arrived in the tower city, Kent’s eyes fell on Saden and Nyxira, seated and chatting over a drink. They are under an umbrella, probably sipping a martini or perhaps a Bloody Mary.
He stood there watching them live the life of luxury.
Not that they didn’t deserve it. It was just strange looking at two terrifying warriors now in their bikinis, sipping wine under an umbrella as they talked about random things.
He even raised his brow when he heard them giggle and laugh every few seconds. The sight is shocking. Nyxira is one terrifying elf assassin who shows no mercy to her prey.
Saden only seems to grow lethal whenever a new Night Rider is added to the fold. Right now, she is the most lethal archer in the tower.
So to see these two ladies. That didn’t shy away from murder now, giggling and laughing, Kent was taken aback.
"It looks like you two are having a good time," Kent said from behind them, causing the tower warriors to stand up and look at him.
"We were training, but Big Sister Selene said we should relax for a while... However, if you have a mission, we will be ready in no time," Nyxira said, looking a little nervous.
"Relax. It’s good that you listened to her suggestion. You two have already done enough missions. Use the next few months to relax before starting the next mission.
Our next mission will be the hardest yet, so relax and have a good time," Kent said to them, smiling.
Watching his smile, the two nodded. They didn’t want to appear like lazy bums, but hearing Kent, they relaxed a bit.
"By the way, where is your disciple?" Kent asked Nyxira.
Since Li Hua wanted to become an assassin so badly, Nyxira took her in as her disciple and taught her the basics while she waited for her to turn 16, when she could start cultivating.
"Li Hua is meditating on that mountain," Nyxira replied with a small smile.
"Meditating?" Kent asked.
"Yes. She seemed fascinated by it, so she started doing it for a while now," Nyxira answered, and Kent could only nod and start walking away.
"Enjoy your afternoon, ladies." He left, leaving the two ladies to sigh and then get back to their drinks while they soaked their feet in the pool.
Up the mountain, Kent saw the little human seated with her eyes closed, possibly in deep thought. Looking at her small face, body, and demeanour, Kent couldn’t help smiling.

"She will be 14 soon. This gives her just two more years before she can start cultivation. I should be prepared to send her to the Dark Region before then." Kent climbed the mountain and sat a few meters from her.
He had roughly 12 hours before the connection with Vexthra would be formed, so he started to wait. Eleven hours later, Li Hua opened her eyes.
The moment her eyes landed on Kent, she jumped into his arms and wrapped her hands around his neck.
"I missed you, Big Brother," she said, not letting go anytime soon.
"I missed you, too, Li Hua," Kent replied, rubbing her back. "I want to take you to meet someone very important to me," Kent said, causing Li Hua to nod.
Kent wanted her to meet Vexthra.
Li Hua was under his protection and had now become a part of his family, so he wanted her to meet one of the most important people in his life.

So while it can’t be proven now, the moment you become a Pill Saint, you will be required to concoct Tier 8 pills, which are for the Pill Sages.
Then, at the Sage stage, you will enter the Pill King stage.
This isn’t to dampen your mood but to prepare you to rise further in your path to the peak.
The master had to know that you must be at the Pill King stage to be taken seriously in any sect or guild in the high worlds.
So, embrace this new change and prepare accordingly.⟫
Dori explained, and Kent could only nod.
"Two enlightenments, huh?
Looks like I have a lot to do.
So I guess its a good thing I have all the time to do them inside the tower."
⟪That is fortunate for you.
Thankfully, there is no time limit this time for you to race against.
So you indeed have all the time in the tower world to learn and reach your goals⟫.
"Now, the only question here is who this Pill Princess is," Kent asked, looking at his three assistants for answers.
However, they just stared at his face and continued to smile.
They knew who this person was, but they wouldn’t tell him, considering it would be worthwhile for him to find out himself.
However, Kent wasn’t stupid.
He knew that for a name or title to be dropped in his requirements, the tower must really hold this person in high esteem.
This made him start to feel giddy for the day he would meet this mysterious person and perhaps look forward to their duel.
But it would have been fun knowing about this Pill Princess for now.
"I will find out one day, then," Kent stood up and vanished, appearing in the tower city.
It had been a long time since he had spent some time with the little human he rescued back in Caprath City.
He plans to spend some time with her.
Li Hua is like his baby sister, so he misses her a bit.
When he arrived in the tower city, Kent’s eyes fell on Saden and Nyxira, seated and chatting over a drink.
They are under an umbrella, probably sipping a martini or perhaps a Bloody Mary.
He stood there watching them live the life of luxury.
Not that they didn’t deserve it.
It was just strange looking at two terrifying warriors now in their bikinis, sipping wine under an umbrella as they talked about random things.
He even raised his brow when he heard them giggle and laugh every few seconds.
The sight is shocking.
Nyxira is one terrifying elf assassin who shows no mercy to her prey.
Saden only seems to grow lethal whenever a new Night Rider is added to the fold.
Right now, she is the most lethal archer in the tower.
So to see these two ladies.
That didn’t shy away from murder now, giggling and laughing, Kent was taken aback.
"It looks like you two are having a good time," Kent said from behind them, causing the tower warriors to stand up and look at him.
"We were training, but Big Sister Selene said we should relax for a while...
However, if you have a mission, we will be ready in no time," Nyxira said, looking a little nervous.
"Relax.
It’s good that you listened to her suggestion.
You two have already done enough missions.
Use the next few months to relax before starting the next mission.
Our next mission will be the hardest yet, so relax and have a good time," Kent said to them, smiling.
Watching his smile, the two nodded.
They didn’t want to appear like lazy bums, but hearing Kent, they relaxed a bit.
"By the way, where is your disciple?" Kent asked Nyxira.
Since Li Hua wanted to become an assassin so badly, Nyxira took her in as her disciple and taught her the basics while she waited for her to turn 16, when she could start cultivating.
"Li Hua is meditating on that mountain," Nyxira replied with a small smile.
"Meditating?" Kent asked.
"Yes.
She seemed fascinated by it, so she started doing it for a while now," Nyxira answered, and Kent could only nod and start walking away.
"Enjoy your afternoon, ladies." He left, leaving the two ladies to sigh and then get back to their drinks while they soaked their feet in the pool.
Up the mountain, Kent saw the little human seated with her eyes closed, possibly in deep thought.
Looking at her small face, body, and demeanour, Kent couldn’t help smiling.
"She will be 14 soon.
This gives her just two more years before she can start cultivation.
I should be prepared to send her to the Dark Region before then." Kent climbed the mountain and sat a few meters from her.
He had roughly 12 hours before the connection with Vexthra would be formed, so he started to wait.
Eleven hours later, Li Hua opened her eyes.
The moment her eyes landed on Kent, she jumped into his arms and wrapped her hands around his neck.
"I missed you, Big Brother," she said, not letting go anytime soon.
"I missed you, too, Li Hua," Kent replied, rubbing her back.
"I want to take you to meet someone very important to me," Kent said, causing Li Hua to nod.
Kent wanted her to meet Vexthra.
Li Hua was under his protection and had now become a part of his family, so he wanted her to meet one of the most important people in his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 490: Vexthra is In the Tower
paragraphs: "I can’t wait to meet her," Unity said, standing beside Kent, clinging onto his hand.

Her sisters were also around. The time for the tower to sync with Vexthra and create a secure connection that would allow Kent to summon Vexthra to the tower was almost here, and thus, they were waiting.
This connection will allow Vexthra to enter the tower but move through the gaps in the laws without any backlash.
Lady Lani and Nara were also around, with the only one absent being Lady Vari, who was minding her own business by cultivating in peace.
Hearing her disciple was safe put her at peace, so she was cultivating while Kent and his ladies waited for the goddess to land in the tower.
"I wonder what she looks like," Lilian said, already looking forward to finding out.
Kent could only smile at their childish behavior. They all wanted to meet the goddess, but it seemed he underestimated their desire.
It was like chicks waiting for their mother on the other side of the river.
If only he knew, currently, Vexthra was also pacing back and forth, waiting for the six hours to pass. Just like how her sisters wanted to meet her, she was also eager to meet them.
She had wanted this moment for a long time, and as such, this was her chance to meet them. Though she will be spending the next couple of weeks, perhaps years with them, she wanted to meet them asap.
"I wonder what they look like," she muttered, already hungry to meet them.
She walked back to her perfectly laid bed and sat down, anxiously tapping her foot on the ground as she waited for the time to come.
A few minutes later, she felt a connection form between her and something profound. This brought a smile to her face. She knew the Tower had finally latched onto her.
Inside the tower, a message appeared in Kent’s vision, bringing a smile to his face.
⟪Tower Message: A connection has been formed between you and Goddess Vexthra. You can now summon her into the tower.
She will be allowed a thirty-day free stay. After that, 100,000 tower points will be deducted for every day she stays in the tower.
Failure to pay means she will be teleported back to the god realm, and it will cost 10,000,000 to summon her back.⟫
The message was like a joke before Kent’s eyes.

Tower points were something he wouldn’t lack again, considering that at the moment, he had already racked up 45 million tower points thanks to Zareth, the rest of the undead, and Veydris, who were currently farming in the twelve SS-rank dungeons he gave them.
Every kill rewarded him with tower points, so he was now rich in that regard. And he would only grow richer as they started the Calamity Quest in the world of Dusk.
In a few days’ time, he would be swimming in Tower Points.
Kent looked at his ladies and smiled.
"Everyone, welcome your big sister," he said, snapping his fingers. A golden portal opened the moment he snapped his finger.
The ladies immediately focused their attention on the opened portal, expecting to see their sister already.
Thankfully, Vexthra was also eager to meet them, so she didn’t make things hard for them by keeping them in suspense.
Through the portal, the most gorgeous woman any of them had ever set their sights on walked through.

It wasn’t a secret that Kent was packing some of the world’s most beautiful fairies inside his tower. However, watching the silver-red head walk through the portal, they knew she was on another level of beauty.
Vexthra was clad in a red gown that clung to her skin, accentuating her assets.
She truly picked the best dress to impress her sisters, for her hips were well framed, and looking at her cat-like steps, it was safe to assume she was really making them see the difference.
Kent already expected something like this, so he wasn’t surprised when he saw her move through the portal.
With the divine goddess aura around her, it was safe to say she was indeed making a difference, charming her sisters with her smile.
She walked through the portal and stopped when she was a few steps from Kent, who was smiling at the goddess who had finally made her way into the tower.
"Hello, everyone," Vexthra said, smiling at the ladies. The ladies were charmed, each standing there with widen eyes.
Li Hua, who was standing on Kent’s left, tugged on his sleeve, causing Kent to turn toward her.
"Is she a goddess?" she asked in a hushed tone, making both Kent and Vexthra smile.

"Yes, I am a goddess, and no need to whisper. You can call me Big Sister Vexthra," Vexthra replied, causing Lilian to smile. Of course, Kent, who knew what this smile meant, knew what was coming next.
While the ladies were charmed by Vexthra’s presence, Li Hua was an exception. Vexthra wasn’t playing with her, so she kept her focus and mind as her own.
The divine aura around her charmed them, making every last one of them stare at her. Vexthra was up to her antics, and Kent could only smile.
Li Hua was also safe from her divine influence. But this was her chance to have a new, beautiful, and rich big sister despite having dozens of them.

She moved closer and started examining Vexthra like she was a patient in Li Hua’s health center. After a while, she smiled and walked back to Kent, jumping into his arms and bringing her mouth closer to his ear.
"Do you think she likes banana cakes?" she asked Kent this time, doing her best to lower her tone even further.
Kent, who knew the brat in his arms meant nothing good by asking this question, chose to entertain her. He was already made aware of Li Hua’s love for money.
She always liked to have money in her life, for she and her grandma were always on the run, and money was the most valuable item for them.
Seeing a beautiful lady, she knew what had to be done.
Vexthra just laughed, knowing her character, for Kent had told her everything when he visited her the first time. But watching her in action was much better, so she was smiling her head off.
Kent was also the same.
"Vexthra, don’t you think it’s time you stopped messing with your sister?" Kent said, looking at how charmed the ladies had become. They were powerless under her divine aura.
Even her smile alone was more than enough to charm them, but Vexthra was using her divine aura to amplify the effect of her charm. So there was no escaping or recovering from that.
"Unity, you can stop faking it. I know you are not charmed," Vexthra, instead of releasing her sister, said to Unity, who was faking being charmed.
However, when exposed, she smiled and jumped into Vexthra’s arms, planting her face in her chest.
"Looks like I was right. She wouldn’t be affected by divine energy," Vexthra said, hugging her tightly.
"This is great, it looks like I wasn’t the only goddess in the tower; there are two of us," Kent, who was watching the two beauties hug, raised his brow, hearing what Vexthra said.

chapters.title: Chapter 491: Big Sister, You Are A Bully
paragraphs: "Big sister, you are a bully," Lilian said as she planted her face in Vexthra’s chest, hugging her like her life depended on it.

"Sorry about that, but I had to test a theory. Thankfully, my theory was validated," Vexthra said with a smile. Now that she had retracted her aura, the ladies were not being affected by her divine aura.

"But take this as a test for what you will encounter as you climb higher in your cultivation. You will meet beings that can easily suppress you with their aura, so take this as my way of showing you that"
They couldn’t hate her for doing that. They knew what she said couldn’t be different from the truth. There are indeed beings out there that can overwhelm them with just their aura.
However, while she was showing them how terrifying an aura can be, she actually did more than that. In the brief encounter, she did more than test their resolve under her aura.
She did two things to them.
First, she planted her divine aura in them. It was buried deep, but she planted it in every last one of them. Even Li Hua wasn’t an exception.
This was to ensure they were not taken over by someone stronger than them.
Her aura would be unleashed when someone stronger than them tried to take over their mind or soul. This was her way of making sure her sisters were always safe.
The second was that she had just exposed Unity as a goddess, causing everyone to wonder if Unity had been using her divine powers on them recently.
They seemed to want her to have all the cosy time with Kent. In fact, even when she was overdoing it, they didn’t seem to care.
But hearing now that she was a goddess, they couldn’t help but wonder if Unity had been charming them all this while.
"Is Unity truly a goddess?" Selene asked.
"Yes. She is a goddess, and from what I sense from her, I have a feeling she is several times more powerful than I," Vexthra said, holding Unity’s hand.
She was making sure she wasn’t too overwhelmed, considering Unity was puzzled upon hearing she was a goddess.
She doesn’t feel like a goddess at all, yet the goddess in the family says she is.
"She is a goddess, but not at the moment," Vexthra said in a mysterious tone.
The ladies who knew what she was hinting at looked at Unity, and for a moment, they could tell she had a different feel to her.

"Alright, no need to make her nervous. We have a lot of time on our hands to figure out what kind of goddess she was. For now, we can only focus on me," Vexthra laughed, causing her sisters to smile with her.
Li Hua was standing on her left, holding her hand. The lover of money wouldn’t let a goddess slip through her fingers.
"We prepared a welcome party for you, big sister," Elsa said, causing her sisters to nod.
"It’s right this way," she said, starting to walk deeper into the Love Garden. Vexthra lifted Li Hua into her arms and started following Elsa with the rest of her sisters.
Soon, Kent was left standing like he was insignificant.
"When did I become unrecognisable?" he muttered, a smile gracing his lips. They had just left him there like he didn’t exist.
"The saying ’you shall know them by their behaviour,’ indeed is true." Kent shook his head and then turned to his left, watching the dark-veiled beauty walk toward him.
"Big sister, how are you doing?" Kent, who saw a chance to become important again, spoke. However, he froze when he sensed something different about Lady Vari.
"Wait, when did you climb from level 3 to level 7 Core Formation Stage?" Kent asked, sensing a rather powerful presence coming from Lady Vari.
"I am here to ask you the same question. I was cultivating quietly when suddenly, my rank jumped from level three to four, and before I knew it, I was shooting through the ranks.
Now, I am at the 7th stage, and this just doesn’t make sense to me. What did you do this time?" Lady Vari asked.
She suspected Kent had something to do with this.
"I did not do... Oh, I see what is happening here," Kent smiled.
"You see what?" Lady Vari asked, looking a little nervous. She had been cultivating for years now, so she knew that rising through the ranks that fast wasn’t always safe.
So she was concerned about her foundation.
"No need to freak out, big sister. It’s the doing of a goddess who doesn’t like minding her own business," Kent laughed. Deep in the Love Garden, Vexthra smirked.
"Are you saying there is a goddess inside the tower at the moment?" Lady Vari asked, watching Kent curiously.
Naturally, there couldn’t be a more perfect time for Kent to brag. Lady Vari asked the perfect question, and Kent has the perfect answer.
"Don’t look too shocked, big sister. I have a goddess in my harem. And let me tell you, all I had to do was smile at her."
*Cough.*
Vexthra, who was currently drinking fruit juice inside the garden with her sisters, coughed upon hearing what Kent said to Lady Vari.
’This brat.’

A smile appeared on her lips, causing her sisters to wonder what was happening to her. However, they didn’t ponder on it since Vexthra chose to stop snooping on all the shameless comments Kent was spilling and focus on the party instead.
Lady Vari was left standing before Kent, not knowing what to say.
"Just who are you?" she asked. She couldn’t understand anything. While she would have doubted Kent if he said this before her sudden level-ups, she couldn’t do that now.
She had climbed four levels, and there was no denying that. So she knew Kent was telling the truth. He indeed had a goddess in his harem.
But if that was true, then just how was that possible? Just how did that even make sense?
"Just who are you, Kent?" she asked again.

"I go by many names. Some called me the Father of Weapon Cultivation. They called me Lord Genesis, some called me the Dragon Lord, the Chaos Dragon, and while I don’t want to scare you, I was also known as the Faceless Assassin.
But you can just call me Sir Kent, the charmer of beauties."
Kent puffed his chest, making Lady Vari wipe the mysterious Kent she had painted in her mind a couple of seconds ago and replace it with a shameless Kent.
"I want to thank her," Lady Vari said.
"Are you sure?" Kent asked, already seeing a trap forming for the Kingdom Protector. She was only in the tower to take advantage of the time difference and enhance spiritual qi.
She had already made Kent aware that she would never become his woman. However, asking to go near Vexthra was a recipe for disaster.
The goddess had clearly set a trap, and she is falling into it.
"I just want to thank her, Kent. It wasn’t like I wanted to challenge her to a life-and-death duel," Lady Vari replied, making Kent smile.
"Your funeral. Not that I mind, so my advice to you: better prepare your voice, for you will be screaming in my bed sooner than you think."
He held her hand, and they teleported to where Vexthra and her sisters were having the welcome party.
Vexthra smiled when her gaze met that of Lady Vari. The Kingdom protector immediately sensed the mischief.

Kent puffed his chest, making Lady Vari wipe the mysterious Kent she had painted in her mind a couple of seconds ago and replace it with a shameless Kent.
"I want to thank her," Lady Vari said.
"Are you sure?" Kent asked, already seeing a trap forming for the Kingdom Protector.
She was only in the tower to take advantage of the time difference and enhance spiritual qi.
She had already made Kent aware that she would never become his woman.
However, asking to go near Vexthra was a recipe for disaster.
The goddess had clearly set a trap, and she is falling into it.
"I just want to thank her, Kent.
It wasn’t like I wanted to challenge her to a life-and-death duel," Lady Vari replied, making Kent smile.
"Your funeral.
Not that I mind, so my advice to you: better prepare your voice, for you will be screaming in my bed sooner than you think."
He held her hand, and they teleported to where Vexthra and her sisters were having the welcome party.
Vexthra smiled when her gaze met that of Lady Vari.
The Kingdom protector immediately sensed the mischief.

chapters.title: Chapter 492: Vexthra, The Goddess of Hatred and Resentment
paragraphs: Lady Vari stood frozen as she locked eyes with Vexthra.
She was stunned, charmed, and in shock.

There were so many things Lady Vari expected to see in this life, but seeing a goddess wasn’t one of them. And if that wasn’t enough, seeing a goddess and then having her smile at her wasn’t something she was expecting.
But Vexthra didn’t mind that. She was now in the midst of her sisters. Something she had wanted for a while, so she was simply too happy.
However, Lady Vari wasn’t as enthusiastic. Even if she was, she currently couldn’t process such emotions. Her mind was in turmoil.
"Hi, I am Vexthra, the goddess of hatred and resentment," Vexthra said, causing Lady Vari and the rest of the ladies to look at her.
This was their first time hearing her title or her divinity. She never told them that until today...
"Don’t worry, it isn’t as bad as you think," Vexthra said, noticing the gaze from her sister falling on her.
"Join us. Kent told me you are his big sister, so I want to know you, considering your little brother is my husband," Vexthra spoke again, making the ladies sigh.
They were planning on getting a deep dive into her divinity.
However, Vexthra had other plans, and that must be addressed first. Lady Vari took a deep sigh and sat beside Vexthra.
"I am sorry if this comes out rude, but how are you a goddess? I mean, how can a goddess—"
"Fall in love with such a brat," Vexthra laughed, ending Lady Vari’s statement. She turned, looking at Kent, who was already cozied up in Mara’s embrace as he got fed by Camilla and Lilian.
"No need to look at me like that. She fell for me so hard that if her fellow gods found out, they would never stop teasing her," Kent said with a smile.
Vexthra smirked while Lady Vari became puzzled. She still couldn’t understand how Kent had a literal goddess in his harem.
"Don’t mind him. He is just a little brat." Vexthra took Lady Vari’s hand and pulled her closer to her side.
"I became his woman because of his courage. When I met him, I wasn’t someone anybody would want to talk to.
After all, my divinity is one of hatred and resentment, so talking to me wasn’t an option. I mean, would you want to approach a god that knows only hate and is filled with only hate?
He approached me and even made a move on me. His courage was unlike any other.

Who would have thought a goddess would find her happiness in the arms of a mortal brat?" Vexthra laughed, and while the ladies could tell her eyes were filled with hatred and resentment, they were also oozing love and affection.
"Big sister, what does it mean to be the goddess of hatred and resentment?" Unity asked, trying to understand how any of this was possible.
Vexthra knew this was something that must be approached, so she decided to let the cat out of the bag once and for all.
"To become a god, there are two things. First, you must transform your immortal aura into a divine aura. You need to do this by undergoing seven different tribulations.
Once that happens, you will be called a Demi-God. This stage is basically where you get a taste of what having divine energy means.
Then from that junction, there are two paths. There are the gods and goddesses who choose to comprehend external laws like Sun, Fire, Moon, Water, Ice, Sword, Bow, and others.
Those are the external laws. If they succeed, their divinity will be named after their law. That is why you sometimes hear titles like Fire God, Moon God, Sword God...
Those are gods and goddesses who came about by comprehending external laws. However, there are others who use the Demi-God stage to get to know themselves.
The common term is sensing themselves. It’s basically like how one comprehends their realms.

If they like what they sense, then they must form a law, which is basically taking their own Law of Self—realm, feelings, wants, and everything they can understand about themselves, and forming a law from it.

Gods and goddesses who come about using this law are some of the most dangerous beings in the universe. Of course, the external gods like the Sword God, Fire God, Void God, and others are equally dangerous.
"But we, the Internal Gods, are much more dangerous. There are many technicalities to this. There can even be a Sword God who came about by comprehending their feelings.
I don’t want to mess with your brains, so let’s take things slowly. We have eternity to figure it out," Vexthra said. The ladies nodded to that.
Strangely, Lady Vari nodded but realized her mistake the next second and turned her head down. She was clearly embarrassed.
"So, I am the goddess of hatred and resentment because that was me-or rather, that was the me I sensed during that critical stage. As such, I became the god that represents hatred and resentment.
My life is full of hate and resentment. I didn’t know love, empathy, or anything that isn’t hate and resentment."
The ladies became quiet upon hearing her words. The only question in their minds was how a person could look within herself and only find hatred and resentment.
That had to be the saddest thing they had ever heard.
"So, I am basically a being of hatred and resentment. I thrive in that region. And well, because of that, I didn’t have any friends for millions of years.
So do you believe me when I say I fell for Kent because of his courage?
He was a mere mortal when I met him, but that mortal changed my life, and while it’s impossible to teach me love, he basically filled my life with an abundance of it.
Look at me now. I am in the midst of mortals who are usually easy to hate, but my presence isn’t making any of you feel hateful.
This is what he did for me. He brought back what I had lost in my quest to become a god.
I can love now. So while he may be a brat, he managed to transform a literal goddess of hate by teaching her love, empathy, and kindness.
I say that is hot, don’t you think?" Vexthra smiled.
The ladies, including Li Hua and Lady Vari, turned and looked at Kent.
However, all they could see was a brat enjoying all the attention he was getting.

chapters.title: Chapter 493: Vexthra’s First Plan For Her Sisters
paragraphs: "You heard the goddess. I am a delicate flower that must be cherished. So hold me firm and never let me go," Kent said, smiling at the beautiful eyes staring at him.
They saw him in a new light.
However, none of them was showing it, considering doing so would make Kent’s head grow bigger and even more shameless.
But the fact that he was able to have such an effect on a goddess was worthy of admiration.
"So while my divinity is rather scary, no need to fear me. I am now just Vexthra, a happy wife of a brat," Vexthra added, and her sisters laughed.
Lady Vari, however, was still in shock, but she seemed to be coming along.
"Thank you for helping me break through to the 7th level of the Core Formation stage," Lady Vari finally said. It was the reason she came there in the first place, to thank Vexthra for helping her.
Now that she did, leaving was the next thing she must do. However, she doesn’t feel like leaving the atmosphere she was in. It was rather calming and incredibly soothing.
"Don’t worry about it. Just firm your foundation, and I will help you fully form your core," Vexthra said to Lady Vari, who nodded at her words.
"Big sister, can you help us too?" Lilian asked, but Vexthra shook her head.
"I can’t help any of you yet. To be able to absorb my energy, you must start forming something called a Spirit Core. That starts at the Core Formation stage.
Without that, you can’t handle my energy. I might indirectly kill you rather than help you." The ladies nodded.
"But don’t worry. Though I can’t help you with your cultivation bases, I have many different ways to help you. The first is making sure your spirit roots grow to the divine stage.
This way, when you get to the Core Formation stage, you can form a bigger core, which will come in handy when you finally ascend to the High Worlds."
Vexthra turned to Lady Vari.
"You can receive this help too. I will help your spirit root grow to the divine stage, which I currently am.
But if you do, your cultivation base will be halted for the next 40 years. Of course, with the time inside the tower, you won’t feel the passing of time."
Lady Vari didn’t know what to say, so she turned to Kent.
"Don’t look at me. She is a goddess; I am just a brat." Kent had already confirmed with his three assistants, so he knew there was indeed a way.
The Ambrosia apples are a way to achieve that. However, there are even better treasures out there that can help mortals grow their spirit roots.
Vexthra is a goddess who has access to a lot. If Kent wanted to do the same, he would need billions of tower points before he could help even one of his women.
But with Vexthra, he wouldn’t spend a dime.

"You don’t have to worry too much. I will destroy the core you’ve formed and then grow your spirit root. This way, when you start creating your core again, it won’t be like the current one you possess.

Let me be plain. This core you are forming will be ranked at the lowest in the higher worlds. Your chance of getting into a sect would be very slim. This means your chances of facing your opponents are next to none.ree
So it’s better we fix that before you ascend."
"Okay," Lady Vari nodded, bringing a smile to Vexthra’s face.
Kent just shook his head, knowing the kingdom protector would be spoiled sooner than he thought. When they first met, Selene was an innocent and elegant saintess.
However, she changed after she met Vexthra. Now, the innocent saintess is as shameless as they come.
The demon goddess has turned her into a sex fiend. So, watching the bright smile on V3xthra’s face, he knew she was up to no good.
The party continued for ten straight hours. Afterwards, they left for Tower City to spend the night inside the Mountain Garden.
Lady Vari was brought along. Vexthra wouldn’t allow her to slip away like the assassin she was.
"Big sister, does it mean you can now fight alongside us?" Elsa asked, but Vexthra shook her head.

"While inside the tower, I can use my goddess abilities, but I am merely a mortal once outside. If I were to use my goddess powers, the laws would punish me and perhaps send me back before I destroy this medium world with my powers.
But don’t worry, you all are capable enough to protect our man, so while I couldn’t fight, I can do that through you all."
"Don’t worry, big sister, we will protect him," Neomi said, looking toward Kent, who was seated at the edge of the mountain with Lady Vari.
"How long do you think she has?" Selene asked.
"I give her a couple of days," Vexthra, who knew what the shameless saintess meant, replied before turning to Lady Lani and Nara.
"You two need to get in his pants faster. Trust me, you’re missing out on a great deal," Lady Lani and Nara blushed. They knew it had to happen soon enough.
Meanwhile, Lady Vari and Kent were having a different conversation.
"You never told me you have a goddess for a wife," she asked, or rather, stated.
"Would you have allowed me to rock your world if I told you?" Kent asked with teasing laughter.
"Be serious, Kent. I..."
Kent took her hand, causing Lady Vari to stop mid-sentence. She looked at the hands holding hers and couldn’t help but look at Kent’s face.

"You don’t have to overthink everything, my beautiful assassin. You now have a goddess willing to help you become overpowered; I say go for it. I don’t know if you know this, but having a goddess on speed dial is great."
Lady Vari could only stare at him while Kent laughed his heart out. Though his way of speaking was unconventional, he indeed knew how to make every conversation fun.
Lady Vari could only sigh and immerse herself in the future she had found herself in. Though she wasn’t Kent’s woman, she knew enough to know she was lucky to have found herself among them.

chapters.title: Chapter 494: Going Out
paragraphs: The goddess of hatred and resentment is in the tower now, meaning the ladies now have a goddess as their sister and trainer.

Yes, it’s the next day already, and Vexthra has already started their training. After the long, enjoyable welcome party, the next morning, she took everyone to the Body Tower and used her own treasures to put them in an herbal bath.
Naturally, they couldn’t handle the herbs she had prepared, so she had to put them to sleep first. Thankfully, they are in the tower where they wouldn’t be in any harm.
After putting them to sleep, she came to spend some time with Kent.
"How are they?" he asked.
"They are fine. The herbs I used will keep them passed out for the next couple of weeks. Perhaps they will be awake in three months’ time," Vexthra responded, hugging Kent for a kiss.
"Just what did you put in their herbal bath?" Kent asked, holding her waist.
"It’s just something small that will open the pathways in their meridians that have been blocked for a while now. This way, when I start their training, their progress will be much quicker.
Unlike you, who have zero impurities in your meridians, they have to clean theirs through body cultivation."
"I see. I guess it’s a good thing they have a capable big sister," Kent said as he raised her by the butt and wrapped her legs around his waist.
He then walked to the edge of the Mountain Garden and locked lips with her.
After a few seconds, he took a gentle step forward and started falling slowly downward while still locked in a gentle and passionate kiss.
The air of love, care, and happiness surrounded them as they fell slowly to the ground. After they touched down, they broke the kiss.
Kent then held her hand, and they started walking through the city.
"What are your plans now?" Kent asked Vexthra, who was walking alongside him.
"I plan on travelling the world with you and my sisters, but seeing that they want to grow stronger first, we can spend some time together whenever you are free.
When they are awake and you give them their True names, we can start our journey," Vexthra said.

She had already made Kent aware she wouldn’t disturb his training time, so she ensured he knew that. She is aware of how much Kent wants to spoil her, but she also wouldn’t want him to waste all his time on her.
"Why don’t we go out? I want to buy some herbs for alchemy, so we can go to Vastport City, and if there is time, we can visit Caprath City.
That was where I arrived when you sent me to this world," Kent proposed.
"That will be great," Vexthra smiled. This was all she wanted. "But I would like to maintain a low profile, so I will put on a veil."
"I wouldn’t want any man lusting over my woman, so the veil sounds like a great idea." Kent planted a deep kiss on her lips.
They left the tower once Vexthra was done preparing.
Kent already had many markers all over the human continent, so they appeared closer to Caprath City, and then he retrieved a simple carriage.
He didn’t want to draw too much attention to himself, so he chose the simple carriage. They entered, and soon, they arrived at the city gate.
"Looks like a lot has happened since the last time I was here," Kent said, looking toward the city gate.
There were guards, but not the ones he remembered. These ones were clad in dark armour and wielded heavy weapons. Almost all of them had a half-mask covering their faces.
Kent used the Enchanted Eye to scan them.
⟪Name: The King’s Guards⟫
→ An elite unit in the King’s army that handles some of the urgent tasks for the king.
→ They are only deployed when the kingdom is in distress.
→ Each guard has undergone brutal training and body modification rituals to enhance their strength, stamina, and pain resistance.
→ Their loyalty is absolute; each wears a blood-bound oath seal under their armour, binding their soul to the service of the King.
→ Their weapons are crafted from Obsidian-Steel, making them highly resistant to elemental magic.
→ It is rumoured that the leader of the King’s Guards, known only as the "Black Fang," has undergone hellish training at the black sea, slaying one of the seven calamities; the Lightning Fang Frog.
→ Whenever the King’s Guard appear, know a kingdom-shattering fugitive is on the loose.
"This is not good," Kent said with a guilty smile as he turned and looked at Vexthra.
"Let me guess—you pissed off someone important, and as such, they’ve deployed their strongest army unit to hunt you down," Vexthra smiled under her veil.
"Well, it’s not my fault all four kings are dumb," Kent smirked.
"Then how are we going to get in, considering they will spot you from a mile away? You are not exactly the type that can be forgotten easily," Vexthra said.
Kent immediately turned to his assistants.

⟪The master already has markers inside the city, so you can just use the tower to teleport inside. This will allow you to evade the guards.⟫ Akira gave her insight on how to solve his current predicament.
⟪That won’t work. Even if the master enters by evading the guards, his chance of being recognised while inside the city is high. And who knows how many of these people are waiting for him inside?
I say the master should just slaughter all of them and be done with it. The moment he shows them he is the man and has appeared again, they will back down,⟫
Gaia said, causing Kent and her fellow sisters to shake their heads.
⟪Dumbhead.. Are you really not aware of what this means? From my perspective, the chances of someone stronger hiding behind the scene and just waiting for the master to appear are very high.
His committing a slaughter now isn’t going to end well for him. So I say you disguise yourself and enter like a normal civilian.
This way, you wouldn’t only be able to move around freely, but you would also be able to enter any place and have the time of your life with Goddess Vexthra.⟫

⟪You can enter with your true face when you reach the stage to roam freely. Of course, you might think this is you being a coward, but from how I see it, this is you compromising to spend time with your wife.⟫
Dori, being the brainiac of the three, brought the perfect plan.
Kent nodded, as he had even thought of the same plan.
"Gaia, I need the best method to disguise myself." Since the three brats were no secret to Vexthra, Kent spoke aloud, allowing her to hear.

sentences.text: The goddess of hatred and resentment is in the tower now, meaning the ladies now have a goddess as their sister and trainer.
Yes, it’s the next day already, and Vexthra has already started their training.
After the long, enjoyable welcome party, the next morning, she took everyone to the Body Tower and used her own treasures to put them in an herbal bath.
Naturally, they couldn’t handle the herbs she had prepared, so she had to put them to sleep first.
Thankfully, they are in the tower where they wouldn’t be in any harm.
After putting them to sleep, she came to spend some time with Kent.
"How are they?" he asked.
"They are fine.
The herbs I used will keep them passed out for the next couple of weeks.
Perhaps they will be awake in three months’ time," Vexthra responded, hugging Kent for a kiss.
"Just what did you put in their herbal bath?" Kent asked, holding her waist.
"It’s just something small that will open the pathways in their meridians that have been blocked for a while now.
This way, when I start their training, their progress will be much quicker.
Unlike you, who have zero impurities in your meridians, they have to clean theirs through body cultivation."
"I see.
I guess it’s a good thing they have a capable big sister," Kent said as he raised her by the butt and wrapped her legs around his waist.
He then walked to the edge of the Mountain Garden and locked lips with her.
After a few seconds, he took a gentle step forward and started falling slowly downward while still locked in a gentle and passionate kiss.
The air of love, care, and happiness surrounded them as they fell slowly to the ground.
After they touched down, they broke the kiss.
Kent then held her hand, and they started walking through the city.
"What are your plans now?" Kent asked Vexthra, who was walking alongside him.
"I plan on travelling the world with you and my sisters, but seeing that they want to grow stronger first, we can spend some time together whenever you are free.
When they are awake and you give them their True names, we can start our journey," Vexthra said.
She had already made Kent aware she wouldn’t disturb his training time, so she ensured he knew that.
She is aware of how much Kent wants to spoil her, but she also wouldn’t want him to waste all his time on her.
"Why don’t we go out?
I want to buy some herbs for alchemy, so we can go to Vastport City, and if there is time, we can visit Caprath City.
That was where I arrived when you sent me to this world," Kent proposed.
"That will be great," Vexthra smiled.
This was all she wanted.
"But I would like to maintain a low profile, so I will put on a veil."
"I wouldn’t want any man lusting over my woman, so the veil sounds like a great idea." Kent planted a deep kiss on her lips.
They left the tower once Vexthra was done preparing.
Kent already had many markers all over the human continent, so they appeared closer to Caprath City, and then he retrieved a simple carriage.
He didn’t want to draw too much attention to himself, so he chose the simple carriage.
They entered, and soon, they arrived at the city gate.
"Looks like a lot has happened since the last time I was here," Kent said, looking toward the city gate.
There were guards, but not the ones he remembered.
These ones were clad in dark armour and wielded heavy weapons.
Almost all of them had a half-mask covering their faces.
Kent used the Enchanted Eye to scan them.
⟪Name: The King’s Guards⟫
→ An elite unit in the King’s army that handles some of the urgent tasks for the king.
→ They are only deployed when the kingdom is in distress.
→ Each guard has undergone brutal training and body modification rituals to enhance their strength, stamina, and pain resistance.
→ Their loyalty is absolute; each wears a blood-bound oath seal under their armour, binding their soul to the service of the King.
→ Their weapons are crafted from Obsidian-Steel, making them highly resistant to elemental magic.
→ It is rumoured that the leader of the King’s Guards, known only as the "Black Fang," has undergone hellish training at the black sea, slaying one of the seven calamities; the Lightning Fang Frog.
→ Whenever the King’s Guard appear, know a kingdom-shattering fugitive is on the loose.
"This is not good," Kent said with a guilty smile as he turned and looked at Vexthra.
"Let me guess—you pissed off someone important, and as such, they’ve deployed their strongest army unit to hunt you down," Vexthra smiled under her veil.
"Well, it’s not my fault all four kings are dumb," Kent smirked.
"Then how are we going to get in, considering they will spot you from a mile away?
You are not exactly the type that can be forgotten easily," Vexthra said.
Kent immediately turned to his assistants.
⟪The master already has markers inside the city, so you can just use the tower to teleport inside.
This will allow you to evade the guards.⟫ Akira gave her insight on how to solve his current predicament.
⟪That won’t work.
Even if the master enters by evading the guards, his chance of being recognised while inside the city is high.
And who knows how many of these people are waiting for him inside?
I say the master should just slaughter all of them and be done with it.
The moment he shows them he is the man and has appeared again, they will back down,⟫
Gaia said, causing Kent and her fellow sisters to shake their heads.
⟪Dumbhead..
Are you really not aware of what this means?
From my perspective, the chances of someone stronger hiding behind the scene and just waiting for the master to appear are very high.
His committing a slaughter now isn’t going to end well for him.
So I say you disguise yourself and enter like a normal civilian.
This way, you wouldn’t only be able to move around freely, but you would also be able to enter any place and have the time of your life with Goddess Vexthra.⟫
⟪You can enter with your true face when you reach the stage to roam freely.
Of course, you might think this is you being a coward, but from how I see it, this is you compromising to spend time with your wife.⟫
Dori, being the brainiac of the three, brought the perfect plan.
Kent nodded, as he had even thought of the same plan.
"Gaia, I need the best method to disguise myself." Since the three brats were no secret to Vexthra, Kent spoke aloud, allowing her to hear.

chapters.title: Chapter 495: Perfect Disguise
paragraphs: ⟪I have a pill that can help you disguise your appearance, making you invisible to anyone below the Spirit Ascension stage,⟫ Gaia said, knowing it was time to cash in some tower points.
However, just when she said that, Vexthra retrieved a skill book from her space ring and handed it to Kent.
⟪Damn it,⟫ the cosmic loli, who immediately knew the content of the skill book, realised her dream of taking in some tower points was shattered by the beautiful goddess.
"This is the perfect Disguise skill, and yes, that is the name of the skill. It basically allows you to create how you want to look.
Unlike the pills that have limitations, this skill allows you to appear as you want anyone to see you. Even gods will only see the new form you will be taking,"
Vexthra explained the skill, causing Kent to turn and look at the line leading through the entrance of Vasport City.
He knew what must be done, so he started calculating the time he had.
"We have 15 minutes before it reaches our turn. This means I only have 15 hours inside the tower to learn this skill." Kent sighed. "Looks like I will be back soon."
"Go ahead, it’s just 15 minutes outside here. I will wait for you," Vexthra said as Kent planted a kiss on her forehead and then vanished back into the tower.
He could easily enter the tower and let Vexthra enter the city, where he would join her. But like Dori said, he was now a fugitive with many hunters after him.
He wouldn’t have the peace of mind to spend time with Vexthra if he entered with his true face.
So he had to change.
Thankfully, Vexthra had the best skill to help him disguise his appearance.
Kent appeared in the Sword Tower, where he quickly pressed the skill book against his forehead.
Thanks to the tower and his comprehension speed, this was his way of learning, perhaps the quickest way to learn a skill.
When he pressed the skill book against his forehead, he appeared in a space where thousands of glowing strings, made of runes, could be seen painting the entire space.
The moment he appeared, the strings started to move. Soon, they formed into glowing golden orbs that illuminated the entire space.
Kent had to close his eyes, blocking the bright light from entering them. A few minutes into this, the light exploded, and two large runes appeared in the air, exuding a powerful divine aura.
They translated to ’Perfect Disguise’.
Kent formed a hand seal that caused the runes to move and enter his forehead.
The moment they did, he woke up inside the Sword Tower, feeling a rather powerful control over one aspect of his being: his appearance.
He quickly checked the details of the skill.
⟪Skill Name: Perfect Disguise⟫
⟪Grade: Divine⟫
⟪Rank: SS+⟫
⟪Description: Control how you look, feel, smell, and sound. You are in control of how you want others to see you.
However, you can’t take on the look of someone alive and in the same realm as you. Good luck.⟫
"How convenient," Kent smiled, reading the description of the skill.
"Now, who do I want to appear like?" Kent pondered for a few seconds, and a smile appeared on his face.
"I doubt looking like someone from Earth will match the damsel in my arms. Though looking like one of those Korean idols wouldn’t be bad."
Kent laughed, remembering those extremely handsome actors he worked with back on Earth.
He was friends with quite a few of them. However, despite having their appearance vivid in his memory, he doesn’t feel the urge to look like them.
Kent pondered for another second, and then a new idea popped into his mind.
"This could work. Jest was basically my past self, so it will be like me taking on my old appearance," Kent resolved to that idea instead.
So he went into deep recollection as he activated the skill and started changing his look. The first thing he changed was his eyes.
It changed from purple to silver. Jest had silver eyes that could mesmerise any lady who locked eyes with him. He encountered quite a lot of such ladies.
Though from what Kent had learned of Jest so far, he hadn’t shown interest in any lady. Of course, he knew it was only a matter of time before some yandere set her sights on him.
His hair shortened, taking on a dark silver colour. Quite a few strands fell on his left eye, giving him that extremely alluring masculine look.
Then his facial features started to change. His cheekbones sharpened, and while the current him was a handsome brat, Jest was in a league of his own.
In fact, he took on the Jest look when he turned 32, so he was much more mature now and very handsome.
His height moved from 6’3" to 6’4", and even his physique was enhanced. He even changed his clothes to a long, flowing black robe trimmed with deep silver threads.
A thick indigo sash wrapped twice around his waist, embroidered with a crest shaped like a coiled dragon.
Though he wasn’t trying to look it, his appearance was that of a swordsman, so he wore a simple leather bracer on his arm. Even his trousers were made of dark leather material.
"This looks more like it," Kent smiled. His voice was still Kent, so he had to fix that, too. Though he can easily speak like Jest, it’s best if he changes his voice too to sound like him.

"This looks more like it," he repeated, this time with a voice mimicking that of Jest. He stood up and went ahead to stretch. After getting acquainted with his new look and form, he vanished back into the tower.
He wanted to surprise Vexthra, so he appeared with his back turned to her. This way, she wouldn’t recognise him immediately.
"You are 14 minutes early," Vexthra said the moment Kent appeared. This means he spent just an hour inside the tower, or perhaps even less than that.
Kent turned and smiled at her, causing Vexthra to widen her eyes the moment her gaze fell on Kent’s face..
"Liking the new look?" Kent asked, seeing the expression in her eyes.
"This look... where did you get this look?" Vexthra asked. It was clear she was taken aback but Kent’s appearance.
"Why, do you know this person?" Kent asked, knowing she wouldn’t react like that if there wasn’t something wrong.
"I don’t know where you got this look, but never use it when you get to the Immortal Worlds. This look belongs to someone very important and respected.
All immortals and gods worship him, and every weapon cultivator would kill just to maintain his integrity. They wouldn’t let you go freely if they found out you disguised yourself as this person."
"Let me guess, this mysterious person is called Lord Genesis," Kent said, and Vexthra’s expression widened further.
"How did you--" Vexthra paused and squinted her eyes. "Don’t tell me you are..."
"Well, my dear goddess, I am Jest, no last name. Of course, if you want, you can call me Lord Genesis, or the—"
"Slave Swordsman," Vexthra finished his sentence.
"Nice to meet you..." Kent smiled, causing Vexthra’s body to shudder.

chapters.title: Chapter 496: Learning About His Past
paragraphs: Vexthra continued to stare at Kent’s face for close to two whole minutes, not knowing what to say.
It was surreal that someone respected and revered in the immortal and god worlds was now smiling at her with a mischievous look on his face.
Lord Genesis, or as most people knew him, the Slave Swordsman, was someone everyone respected. The legacy he left behind was one that nobody could measure up to—not even celestials.
As the first ever to rise to the peak of weapon cultivation, his name was known by all. So she most certainly didn’t expect the said Lord Genesis to be staring at her at this moment.
"Are you being serious?" Vexthra asked.
"Why would I lie to you? This is indeed one of my incarnations," Kent said with a smile. "Are you shocked?"
"Well, it’s not exactly every day you meet an idol of many gods," Vexthra said, smiling behind her veil. "Even I was part of those gods."
Kent chuckled, knowing this would be weird if he one day got to the higher worlds.
"Tell me about this Lord Genesis." They still had some time before they reached the entrance. This meant they had more than enough time to learn more about his past self, so he asked.
He had already started learning about his past self and knew quite a lot, but hearing from an outside perspective could go a long way.
And while this could be considered Vexthra telling him about his past, like how she did for the Dragon Lord, which was also Kent’s past self—
This time, there wouldn’t be backlashes simply because what she knew was public knowledge. The laws wouldn’t penalize him.
"I personally don’t know much about him, but from the little I do know, Lord Genesis was the first ever to touch the Sword Dao.
It was he who first saw the path beyond the Sword King stage, which, according to weapon cultivation, is the point where one touches the Dao.
Before him, the highest one could rise was the king’s stage. However, he transcended that limit.
It was said that he carved the foundation of all other sword paths, and while he was a swordsman, he contributed greatly to other weapon paths like the bow, spear, lance, and others.
You would have to get inside the Supreme Library and read the sealed archives, which are basically inaccessible, even to me, who is a god.
But his legend is known by many, and while you can find some bits and pieces here and there, he has done a lot over his life."
"I see. Sounds like that brat was some big shot, huh?" Kent smiled, closing his eyes as he recalled his life back when he was Lord Genesis.
"Tell me, do you know where he was from and whether that place is still standing?" Kent asked. He most definitely would want to visit that world when he gets to the high worlds.
"If what is recorded is true, then he is from a world called Byrmrr. Back then, it was a high world, but now it seems to have transcended and become a unique world.
This was so that gods and others who can’t enter high worlds freely can enter and learn more about their idol."
"I see. That is great," Kent said, feeling a weight lifted off his chest.
Knowing the world he was born in during his life, as Jest was still standing, made him happy. This was all he was looking forward to for now.
"Another thing. Byrmrr has another name. They call it the Sword World simply because it still has the sword left behind by Lord Genesis.
This isn’t a rumor—it’s actually in that world, and from what I know, nobody has been able to remove it for billions of years."
Kent narrowed his gaze, hearing this.

"Though I don’t know much about my life as Jest, this doesn’t sound like something I would do. Perhaps I should visit that world and learn more about it," Kent said, knowing deep down, he most certainly wouldn’t do something like that.
It just doesn’t feel like him. So he had to find out, and from what he already knew, getting to that world would be much more ideal.
"Let’s not get ahead of ourselves, shall we?" Vexthra smiled behind her veil.
"Unique worlds are those that don’t have limitations on them. Though there are only a few, they house some of the most dangerous cultivators in the world.
The limitation that prevents us gods from freely descending isn’t present there, so we can descend and freely use our powers.
This means you can easily meet a god, and if they don’t like your smile, they’ll squash you like a bug. You may not know this, but not all gods can think straight—some are unhinged.
So perhaps rise to the ranks of a Spirit Lord or even higher. That way, I can help you investigate this if you still want to when you get there."
Kent nodded. The last thing he wanted was to get squashed by a god just because they didn’t like the way he smiled.
"I still can’t believe you are Lord Genesis," Vexthra said, but Kent just smiled.

"Though I don’t like to brag, if my being Lord Genesis is a shock to you, then wait till you find out about my other incarnations." Kent didn’t want to jinx it, but he most certainly couldn’t wait to uncover the secrets of his past selves.
"How many incarnations do you have?" Vexthra asked, sounding hesitant. She didn’t want to provoke the laws, so she hesitated.
"I have thirteen incarnations. But I only know of three. However, to avoid angering the laws, I won’t tell you."
Vexthra nodded, knowing what he said was indeed the case. The laws exist to ensure that some things remain hidden until they are meant to be known.
"It’s our turn now," Kent said, walking out.
He handed their fees to the guards, and then they entered the city. The guards didn’t even ask about his identity, considering a powerful aura had washed over them the moment it reached their turn.
They would have been surrounded if they had suspected even a trace of Kent on them.
"Let’s visit the Silver Leaf Auction House first." Kent led Vexthra toward the auction house.

He handed their fees to the guards, and then they entered the city.
The guards didn’t even ask about his identity, considering a powerful aura had washed over them the moment it reached their turn.
They would have been surrounded if they had suspected even a trace of Kent on them.
"Let’s visit the Silver Leaf Auction House first." Kent led Vexthra toward the auction house.

chapters.title: Chapter 497: Visiting the Silver Leaf Auction House
paragraphs: The moment Kent and Vexthra arrived at the entrance of the Silver Leaf Auction House, the guards stopped them.
Kent knew they wouldn’t recognize him, considering his appearance had changed. They wouldn’t dare stop him if he were to be in his true appearance.
"State your business," one of the guards said. Today wasn’t an auction day, considering Lady Lani hadn’t been seen in a while, so visiting wasn’t ideal.
However, Kent didn’t take offense at the rude tone the guard used. After all, he was just doing his job.
"I have business with the auction master," Kent responded.
Hearing him say that, the guards became hesitant. The mention of the auction master made them take a step back. Making the wrong move could cost them their job, so they had to tread carefully.
"Do you have any proof to show you indeed have business with the auction master?" one of the guards asked, making Kent smile.
He had already expected this, but in the spirit of spending time with Vexthra, he chose to enter the normal way.
He could have teleported inside, considering he had markers all over VIP Room 13.
However, he was only doing this because Vexthra wanted to feel like she was back to her old self. She wanted to feel like herself millions of years ago, when she was just a flame demon mortal.
So Kent didn’t want to deny her every small detail mere mortals like him would have to deal with.
"Do you know what this is?" Kent asked, taking out a dark-gold apple from his space ring.
"This is the dark-gold rank ambrosia apple. In case you haven’t heard of it, then know it’s something kings would go to war over." Kent chuckled, making Vexthra giggle.
"Now, do you still want to keep me waiting outside, or should I shout for your boss to hear me?" The guards most certainly didn’t want that, so they made way for the brat to enter.
Looking at how he was dressed and the lady standing beside him, it didn’t take a genius to know they were some wealthy people here on business.
"Let’s go, milady." Kent took Vexthra’s hand, and they walked into the auction house. The moment they entered, a lady Kent had seen on multiple occasions approached them.
She was the sales lady who handled most of his items during the annual auction.
"Welcome to the Silver Leaf Auction House. How may we be of help today?" Her tone was polite and well-tuned for someone who was meant to handle the rich and wealthy.
"Lady Lani sent us," Kent said, making Vexthra turn and look at him. She wanted to ask, really, but she decided to go with the flow.
Lady Lani had the faintest idea he was currently using her name in her own organization.
"Kindly follow me," the lady said as she started walking to her office a couple of steps away.
Kent and Vexthra began following her in. Along the way, Vexthra tapped Kent’s shoulder, but the brat didn’t mind her and just kept walking.
This caused Vexthra to giggle, knowing her mischief was caught by Kent from a mile away. He knew she wanted him to notice the lady walking in front of them, but Kent didn’t fall for that.
A few seconds later, they entered the office and sat down.
"Do you know where my lady is? She has vanished for a while now without any message. It’s unlike her."

While she said it was unlike her, she was just being concerned. Over the past years, Lady Lani had vanished for months, sometimes even a year, so showing concern after she disappeared for a couple of weeks was just her being a concerned manager.
"She is fine." Vexthra decided to get involved, considering this was her chance to feel more mortal.
"She is in seclusion, so she won’t be back for a while," she added.
The lady nodded. "In that case, why did my lady send you?" she asked.
In response, Kent retrieved a space ring and handed it over to her.
"She said she wouldn’t be back for a while, perhaps a couple of years, so she wants you to handle these items. It contains enough to keep the auction house afloat for a while.
She said you shouldn’t sell everything at once. Use it to keep the auction house afloat until she returns."
The lady didn’t want to argue about it, so she stored the ring and thanked them.
"If possible, please tell my lady we miss her."
Kent just smiled. "We will tell her."
He only came there to ensure Lady Lani’s auction houses kept running while she was away. This was why he spent 20 million tower points to get all these items for them.
In the coming years, the four kingdoms will have some of the wildest and perhaps rarest treasures auctioned. Kent made sure of that.
After a few minutes, they left the auction house and headed to where he had wanted to go.
The Alchemist Dream.
One of the biggest hubs for alchemy equipment in the four kingdoms. Since he was now a Pill Grandmaster, he wanted to buy ingredients he could use to practice.
He had attained perfect purity for Tier 3 pills, but now has to handle Tier 4 and 5, which in this case means he must enhance his techniques.
Thankfully, he had them and more than enough money to buy herbs for practice.
Once he gets the hang of it, he will try and complete some of the requirements to become a Pill Saint.
He also had plans to sell some of his pills, which would earn him more recognition—something all alchemists wanted.
Though his name was already known as the Perfect Alchemist, it would just be a name without his pills circulating in the system.
The moment people start fighting over his pills, his name as an alchemist will begin to spread.
"The last time I was here, some brat with a badge tried to overestimate her authority," Kent said, riding in the carriage with Vexthra as they headed toward the Alchemist Dream.
"Was she the disciple of the Wicked Poison Witch?" Vexthra asked, causing Kent to shake his head.
"So they told you about her, too."
"Yes. Unlike you, my sisters don’t keep secrets from me," Vexthra said, and Kent smiled.

"There is nothing to tell. I sensed she had poison in her blood, so I helped her and let her go. She didn’t offend me, so I had no reason to go after her. Plus, she even offered to become my servant, but I let her go for now," Kent answered, and Vexthra just chuckled.
"Do you even know who she is?" Vexthra asked.
"Of course. While on the surface, she appears to be the Wicked Poison Witch, her background is actually very deep. I have a feeling we’ll learn more about her soon."
"I only hope nothing happens to her before she can come serve you. We wouldn’t want a potential sister getting hurt."
Vexthra giggled again, but this time, she didn’t let Kent say anything and just locked lips with him, jumping onto his lap.
Soon, they arrived at the Alchemist Dream and entered after Kent bribed the guards again, like he did the first time he came there.

chapters.title: Chapter 498: Vexthra Made a Blunder
paragraphs: "Welcome to the Alchemist’s Dream. How can we be of service?" Someone approached them when Kent and Vexthra stepped into the large store filled with herbs and people.
The moment Kent set his sight on this figure, a smile appeared on his face. The last time he was there, this same lady had tried to get him on her side.
She was from a merchant family that specialised in alchemy, and as such, she wanted Kent, whom she saw as fresh new blood, to join her family.
However, she ran when Kent and Annabelle’s situation started.
But who could blame her? She may have been from a merchant family, but she most definitely wouldn’t go against someone like Annabelle, who was the disciple of a Pill Saint—
The wicked Poison Witch at that.

That would have been like asking for trouble, so Kent didn’t blame her for abandoning him when she did. However, looking at her now, smiling at the new Kent like she had in the past, he couldn’t help but chuckle inwardly.
"I am here to purchase herbs from Tier 3 to Tier 7," Kent said, causing the lady to look up at him. The mention of Tiers 6 and 7 took her by surprise.
Of course, this made her turn and look at the veiled Vexthra. She knew that for such a youngster to boldly say he wanted to purchase Tier 6 and 7 herbs had something to do with the lady beside him.
Vextra is millions of years old but still cute, young, and beautiful. But while she appears young, the air around her shows that she is much more mature than Kent.
One could tell with just a glance.
So sensing the air of maturity around Vexthra, the lady turned and looked at her.
Of course, Kent expected. She did not hate the lady for abandoning him the last time. But that doesn’t mean they are about to pick up from where they left things the last time.
So when he saw her staring at Vexthra, he knew what had to be done. This was his chance to avoid the lady asking him a whole lot about his background and what he looks forward to in his alchemy path.
"This is my master. You can call her Pill Saint Vex," Kent said, causing Vexthra to cough a few times.
’Since when did I become your master? Do I even know alchemy?’ Vexthra used the harem connection to speak to Kent.
’Just go with the flow, my love. You want to be mortal again, so these are just some things we mortals do,’ Kent responded, making Vexthra take a deep sigh.
’Fine, but if you don’t reward me after, I’ll be mad.’ Kent could only smile inwardly and then turned to the lady.
"I would appreciate it if you don’t disclose this to anyone. Not all alchemists want to be public figures, so keep my master a secret," he said, walking closer to her.
"Can you do that?" he asked, and the lady nodded like a baby. Staring at his crazy, sharp eyes scared her a bit.
Being in the presence of a Pill Saint wasn’t something she expected, so she was caught off guard. But hearing Kent’s warning, she wouldn’t go about disclosing this to anyone.
"In that case, where can we get all these herbs?" Kent retrieved a long list and handed it over to the lady.
"That is pretty long. Are you sure you can afford everything on it?" she asked, but Kent just smiled and turned to his master.
"I hope you came prepared, Master," Kent said to Vexthra, who smirked under her veil and turned toward a section of the store where a golden herb box rested on a shelf, surrounded by many formations.
There is something about the box that caught her attention.
"Can we start there? And don’t worry—we came prepared for everything on that list." The lady, seeing where Vexthra pointed, quickly moved in that direction.
She may have been an agent from a merchant family, but also worked at the Alchemist’s Dream. And as such, she earned commissions from every client she helped.
So, seeing Vexthra point to the golden herb box, she became excited.
"What is inside?" Vexthra asked.
Of course, she already knew. She might not be able to use her god powers here, but she was still a god. Seeing through a formation-protected herb box was nothing difficult for her.
The lady walked closer. Under the jealous gazes of her fellow workers, she smiled and began to speak about the herb hidden in the box.
"It’s the Starfire Herb, said to grow only in pure lava. It was retrieved by a group of herb hunters a couple of weeks ago during an expedition to the Ancient Battlefield of Parting.
It’s a Tier 7 herb. It was meant to be auctioned, but since the Silver Leaf Auction House hasn’t opened for a while, we placed it here for those rich enough and interested enough to have it.
It is the main ingredient in making Fire Resistance pills. Many had come to see if they could purchase it, but the payment method wasn’t something they could produce, so they couldn’t have it."
"I see. In that case, I would like to purchase it. How much?" Vexthra asked, showing signs that she truly wanted the herb. This made Kent wonder what she wanted it for.
"I’m sorry, distinguished customers, but this herb can’t be purchased using spirit stones. The owners requested that it be exchanged for something of equal value that is not a herb."
"Oh really," Vexthra took a deep breath, thinking about how to handle the situation. After a few seconds, she retrieved an item from her space ring and handed it to the lady.
"This is a pseudo-mystical-grade technique. I believe it’s equal to—if not more valuable than—this herb." The lady received the book with shaky hands.
The jaws of the onlookers dropped when they heard what Vexthra had just said.
"A pseudo-mystical-grade technique? Isn’t that almost a mystical-grade skill?" one of them asked.
"I know, right? The last time I heard of something like this was during the annual auction eight years ago, when the four kingdoms fought tooth and nail for a skill of this level.
To think someone could just walk into a herb store and pull out such an item... just who is this person?"
Vexthra, overhearing the whispers, sighed and spoke to Kent through their connection.
’I made a blunder, didn’t I?’ She could already feel the hungry eyes starting to lock on them.

’It happens every day. Just this time, you may have enticed them with your riches. But don’t worry—if anyone tries anything funny, I’ll handle them.’ Kent smiled and chose to let Vexthra finish her business.
"Please follow me," the lady said, lifting the golden herb box and walking toward a certain door. A few seconds later, Kent and Vexthra vanished from view.
That was when the murmurs turned into quiet chaos.
People started pulling out their communication devices.
Messages were sent.
Faces turned serious.
And outside the Alchemist’s Dream, unseen eyes had already taken interest.
